title: GReat Bronzer For Medium To Lighter Skin Tones, But Great Eye Shadow Too- Read On
text:
As a makeup artist, I am always trying to find ways to get the most mileage out of the products that I use. This bronzer had some surprises to it. Read on..

PHOTO- My photo has swatches of both color 1 and 2 which are labeled. I tried to get accurate photos colorwise and it is hard to do as the camera does not capture the nuances. When applied with a brush, the effect is MUCH lighter.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
COMPACT
The compact is a high layered cardboard with a strong hinge to it. There is no mirror and the pan inside has the product with designs pressed into it. It does not come with a brush.

WHAT IS THE COLOR LIKE?
This color is more of a bronze gold color. It is still on the cooler side, but light warmer skin tones could use this too.

TYPE OF SKIN TESTED ON?
This was tested on both MAC translation of skin tones NW 25 (which is what you see in the photos) and NC37 which is a more tan but cooler skin tone.

HOW TO APPLY?
This applies well but you have to be sure you find the right brush. A stippling brush was the best way to get a natural look from this bronzer and highlighter. It allows for subtle application so that it does not look like you have on too much. If you use too dense of a brush, it is easy to get a stripe of glow on your face that others will see and it can really look odd. You also need to get a fresh brush and blend it very well into your skin. Apply this in the backwards 3 figure on each side of your face. Imagine two 3s in a mirror image on your face with the tips and centers touching.

ANY OTHER USES?
I found that this also makes a fabulous eye shadow. I found it to be a perfect match with the other color in this series of number 2 which is a darker more rose brown color. This is a great companion to that. If this is all you have, It also makes a great eye shadow alone or with another lighter satin finish shadow or even a matte. I would not go super frosty.

HOW TO APPLY TO EYES
In terms of eyes, you can use this as a contour, all over color, or in combination with the other darker color of this Sungasm series or another set of shadows. The application is best for a lighter look to use a teardrop shaped brush. Then for a heavier look with more color, a flat eye shadow brush packing this gently into place over a good eye primer is the way to go. For a quick application, you can also use a finger to apply and blend it with a brush or your finger

ANY IRRITATION PROBLEMS?
I am VERY sensitive and did not have any problems with this product on the face or eyes.

THE BOTTOM LINE
As long as you are willing to take some time to find the right brush for the application of this, this bronzer is a pretty color especially for cooler toned skin. It is a good highlighter for darker skin tones as a highlighter, though. This is beautiful on the face, eyes, and in tandem with the other color of this bronzer too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a nice bronzer and I am surprised at how well it works on cooler skin tones, something that is not all that easy to find, especially in TWO colors of a collections.

title: Nice As Bronzer On Cooler Toned Skin, But Fabulous Eye Shadow Too,- Read On
text:
I am a makeup artist. I am always finding ways to make cosmetics work for all sorts of uses to get the best look and bang for the buck. This Luminating Bronzer has some surprises up its sleeve.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
COMPACT
This comes in a heavy cardboard compact with a strong cardboard hinge on it. There is no mirror. The pan inside has printed letters and design on it. In this case, the color is number 2, the darker of the two in this collection.

WHAT COLOR IS THIS?
This bronzer is a unique color. Instead of being the usual brown or orange color so many bronzers are, this one is a rose toned base which at first seems unusual. If used on cooler toned skin, you will still see a luminzer effect but the undertone is more of a rose tan.

WHAT COLOR SKIN DID I USE THIS ON?
Right now, I tried this on two colors of skin. One was translated into MAC foundation color as NC27- a tanned color which leans toward the cooler side, and NW25 which is a cooler lighter caucasian leaning color.

EFFECTS?
Things like this have a need for you to choose the right brush. The wrong brush can make it look horrible. The right brush can make it look like a million bucks. When used with a STIPPLING brush (look that up to find out what that means), this bronzer provides the perfect luminescence and glow along with color.

You can see the cheekbones highlighted and see the spot of color, but it is subtle, and not overbearing.

If you use the dense fluffy brush like you might use to apply blush, the results border on ridiculous. It is like you have smears of bright shimmer on and it is hard to blend in well.

WHAT OTHER USES?
Interestingly, I have both color 1 and 2 of this line of Sungasm bronzers. When using this particular color 2 on the creases of the eyes, it provides a GORGEOUS natural look similar to the old J Lo type look or other natural based looks which in reality take a lot of makeup but they just don't look like it.

This put together with color 1 in this series, the two together make a great duo on the eyes. It really is amazing. It brings out the color of the eyes perfectly. In fact, I use the lighter one on the upper cheekbones for highlight/bronzer and the darker number 2 under it and blend well. The effect is subtle but beautiful.

HOW TO APPLY TO EYES
I have used good shadow brushes and my finger as well. The idea is for medium to subtle color, use a tear drop shaped shadow brush. For more intensity use a flat eye shadow brush on top of eye primer and blend once you have applied the other colors. For a quick application, I have successfully used my fingers.

DOES IT BURN ON THE EYES?
I have a terrible time with products on my eyes. They usually burn and give me trouble. This bronzer did not do that. If you are concerned, be sure to get a good eye primer that you are comfortable with and use that first on your eyes.

WHAT ABOUT DARKER SKIN TONES?
If you use this on darker skin tones, there is a good chance it could show up a bit on the ghostly side. It has to be applied very lightly and blended well a little at a time to test the best depth if you want to try it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Not only as a gorgeous rose based bronzer highlighter, but also as a contour or all over eye shadow, this color bronzer is a great price with good performance. It is not the usual color for bronzers but it works on medium to lighter skin tones.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a great multi purpose product for summer. It doubles as bronzer and luminzer but also as a great eye shadow.

title: Halloween Or Messing Around Okay, But Serious Wear, Not So Much
text:
I have been working with wigs for quite a few years now. One thing I know is a good quality vs not so great quality wig. Let's take a look at this one.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?

HAIR
This wig has some great hair. the colors are definitely platinum white and what I would call light auburn base hairs. The white hairs are about 1/3 or so longer than the auburn hairs. There is a nice kink to the hairs.

THICKNESS
That is where this wig is sadly lacking. At the top, the wefts of hair are way too far apart. The lace in the cap is a very light butter colored yellow. The hair is not too thin, but it is not quite thick enough to cover hair below. Yes, this comes with a nylon cap, but it just is not comfortable with those. If you have dark hair it will definitely show the bright colored lace and elastics through the wig when the wind blows.

BANGS/STYLE
That is where this wig is just not practical unless you don't mind looking stupid for a party or Halloween. The bangs are WAY too long for anyone to wear. That usually would not be a problem, but what you will get instead of the cool light ends on the entire head is chopped bang that is bland looking and then these white cool looking ends around the head. The bangs are best cut painstakingly so that the auburn is cut way shorter (about 2/3) than the white hairs. That takes a lot of time but worth the effort. Then you have to cut them at a staggered manner.

Other than the bangs being hard to trim so you can at least function with this wig on, the overall style is fabulous. I love how it falls and looks while on the head.

ELASTIC BANDS
Inside the wig, there are elastic bands with hooks to help hold the wig on the head. You might want to take them down to the spot you like it in as the hooks have a tendency to come undone during wearing.

WHAT I WANT IN A WIG
Believe it or not, I would actually wear a wig like this with the right outfit, and not to be silly either. I prefer wigs that look authentic,, and can be worn realistically as well as for fun.

1. I have to be able to see out of it
2. I have to be able to wear it comfortably without fussing
3. I want it to not have my real hair showing
4. I want it to look realistic
5. I want it to last for quite a few wearings

DOES THIS WIG PASS THE TEST?
I am giving this wig THREE stars because it is hard to wear and see. In order to trim this in a realistic manner, I have to take a LOT of time and that takes stars off for me. I happen to love the style and coloring, so I am wiling to put the work into it, but honestly, I think it should be a bit shorter in the bangs area since it is so hard to trim and keep it looking real. Also, the wefting on the top is just a bit too widely spaced. I wish also that the cap was made with light auburn lace and elastic instead of the icy yellow colors.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you want to wear this for fun, it will be hard to see and hard to trim and not look silly in this. It is comfortable and the style is epic, but there will be work required. You can bandana it to help, but it still will look a bit floppy unless trimmed a little bit in the bangs/fringe area. I like this, but it takes work to wear and not look silly for me.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. The trimming of the bangs is VERY time consuming since we only have one shot at it and if it is screwed up, then the wig is toast. I wish there was more hair on top and that the lace cap did not show as easily. A darker cap underneath (light auburn color) would have been much nicer with this. I will still use this, but it could have been a bit nicer with small inexpensive changes.

title: Used For Watercolors, It Works Well For Small Details

title: Seems To Work, But I Think Mine Might Be Going Rancid
text:
I am all about natural skin care. When I read about this product and the lovely smell it had, I was very excited to try it. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This cream is yellow in color- very pale yellow. It is creamy but not heavy. There is a very faint lemon smell, but there is also a smell which is not good- almost like the oils in the cream are about to turn completely rancid. They are not quite there yet, but I have used enough products over time where I recognize that smell.

That is not necessarily the fault of the cream. This could have been kept in a hot warehouse too long, or who knows what. The manufacture date on my box is April 2019. That is over a year old already.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
Since it is not unbearable at this point, I wanted to at least test the product for a few days. There was no burning or stinging, so it is still okay to use for now. The product is quite nice. It does soak in quickly and it does not leave the face greasy at all.

WHAT IS THE EFFECT ON SKIN?
The next morning after using this, I will say that the skin is left looking like it has a slight glow to it. It does leave the skin looking much nicer than other creams I have used. It is warmer weather right now and this cream is still not leaving the face greasy or heavy at all. My skin is definitely left looking nice the next morning.

ANY SENSITIVITY?
I have not had any sensitivity to the sun or anything else yet. Like I said, I can not use this long as it is ready to turn bad soon so I only have a short time. For now, it is really nice.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I really wish that this cream was fresher than it is. The product manufacture date on it is April of 2019. I am really disappointed that I could not test it at its best because it has great potential to be a really nice cream.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS- I can not give this five stars in its current state. It is potentially really nice cream though. If you get a fresh one, I imagine it is really nice. Just make sure to use it up and if you live in a hot climate, keep it in the refrigerator or air conditioning.

title: Simple Scent Free Skin Care Absorbs Easily Does It Do What It Says?
text:
I am always on the lookout for really nice simple skin care. Let's take a look at this ampule.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a clear solution that comes out with an eye dropper.

HOW TO USE
The idea is that you use a toner on your CLEAN face, apply this to the face and neck and chest, and then follow up with a moisturizer.

WHAT DOES IT PROMISE TO DO?
This promises to lighted dark spots, and add firmness, glow, and hydration.

DOES IT DO WHAT IT SAYS?

DID SKIN LOOK FIRMER?
I guess you could say my skin looked a bit firmer, but nothing so dramatic that people said, "WOW, WHAT ARE YOU USING ON YOUR FACE?"

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a scent free, easy to use serum for the face. It works well with moisturizer, is simple, scent free, and gives a moderate amount of what it says it will do. It is not remarkable, but it is not terrible either.

title: Best Battery Powered Brush We Have Ever Used Cleans As Good As Clarisonic Which We Also Have
text:
We have been through several Clarisonic brushes in our house (Mine kept dying) and my daughter swears by her Clarisonic Mia. She has to go to a camp which has a lot of other teens at it for a week to work for a city reach out program. She wanted to bring her Clarisonic, but I talked her into trying this one out. It is easy to transport and use and if it is lost or taken, it is not as expensive to replace.

WHAT IS THIS BRUSH LIKE?
First of all, this comes in a nice hard case which is great for travel. It comes with one soft brush for daily use and a harder brush for once a week or so use. There is a silicone brush head which is for dry sensitive skin types. The brush runs on batteries which did not come with our unit. They are AA batteries. There are two speeds- slower for daily use and higher for the harder brush to exfoliate.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
There are two speeds. The first speed is very slow and my daughter is not fond of it. She prefers to use it on the second speed which is faster. Since it runs on batteries, it is not going to have the consistency as a plug in version. My daughter prefers the exfoliating brush and uses it 2 times a week. She feels that it cleans her skin as good or better than her Clarisonic Mia as it gets rid of the dead skin cells leaving her skin softer and more clear too.

It seems to be very waterproof. My daughter uses this in the shower and has had no problems with it. After almost a month of use, twice a week, she is not having problems with the batteries running down yet. She does a lot of house sitting so having this handy has been great.

AFTER EXFOLIATING BRUSH
After using the exfoliating brush, my daughter wanted me to mention that it is important to put on good moisturizer as the skin has been exfoliated well and you will need to make sure to use moisturizer on the face to protect the skin as it repairs.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you want the cleaning of a Clarisonic Mia but want something more travel friendly that cleans well, this might be a brush for you to try out. Working best on the second speed with the exfoliating brush, twice a week does the trick for our daughter. She really likes it and thinks it works as good or at times better than her Clarisonic Mia which she still has.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS for this one although it is not fair to grade it against the Clarisonic which is electrically powered, it works as well but does have the battery power. I debated giving it four stars, but it does work better than any battery powered brush we have tested so far, so I am leaving it at five. The soft brush is not too great, though, so perhaps see this as FOUR AND A HALF.

title: Nicest organizer of this type I have seen has clear attention to detail
text:

Just so you're clear, you get a base with four drawers, each with an flattened oval shaped pull, each lined with a black textile that can be removed or used as you choose. The edges of the drawers are beveled, giving this an aura of elegance, but most importantly, each drawer slides in and out with ease, regardless of whether or not the drawer is packed or empty. The bottom of the base has a little strip in the form which raises this organizer from sitting directly on the counter, so if it is used in a bathroom, air can circulate around the entire piece and grungy mildew and such is reduced from forming. Don't forget to dust, though. The exterior edges are beveled, giving them a very finished appearance, unlike those sharp edges on many similar products in the marketplace.

Included with this organizer are two additional pieces, each is the same dimension as the interior of the top ridge of the chest organizer, so you can decide which one you want to put on top and which one you want to put next to the main component. Or you can separate them entirely and use the top of the organizer to put items and use the two multi-sectioned components separately. You could line them up side by side along a dresser top and have more width rather than extended height.

I love the assorted sizes of the sections and the angles top of the shorter of the two pieces. I also love the rounded design in the sections of the taller component. Every aspect of this trio is outstanding, high quality, and it makes quite the impression in addition to comfortably storing whatever you like in each compartment. Each edge is finished, every detail has been considered, and it is even practical in that it can quickly be cleaned with no harsh detergents. This lovely item was made in China and it is clear that quality control is important to the manufacturer because I saw no defect even after intense examination. Be prepared for a weightier set than you might expect, because there was no skimping on the materials. It is perfectly packed for protection and is ideal for presenting as a gift. title: I only use La Prairie  (this is the newest version of the name) products - for 12 years now!
text: Since there aren’t any reviews for this product, I thought I would write one for those who aren’t familiar with the brand, or the item. I’m now 66 years old and have been using only La Prairie products for my face since 2009/10. My face looks better than ever because of it. This item in particular is a very gentle, easy to apply and use, facial cleanser that doesn’t require any water or actual washing process. It goes on a cotton pad (not the balls!), and not too much either, and you gently wipe your face and eye lids going in a circular motion - and always apply outwards and upwards. This will help your skin from being pulled down, which can cause more wrinkles. The company has changed the exact name of the product, but it’s the same (only an improved version) as it always has been. For me, I use this as the first step in my nightly facial ritual - which is to cleanse the face. I follow with other products in stages, finishing up with the moisturizer (one for the face and a different one for the eyes). My rating of this being sold online is hard, since it’s a wonderful product, however it’s outrageously overpriced for what’s a ‘trial size’ and ‘free’ gift, given out with purchases of a full size La Prairie item (depending on how much you spend, and where you buy, it might be just one of multiple free trial size items). The FULL size of this item is about $100 USD, and it’s around 8 ounces +/-. The bottle is probably 8” high and a couple inches wide at least. So part of my rating is based on the product itself and the other part is on the price for this size. Another thing I want to mention is that I have sensitive skin and have never had any issues with this product line! You’re face will thank you!

So I feel this oxytocin perfume calmed down my anxiety in general which made other people around me more open and friendly.

To be honest this was a surreal and dreamy experience. I felt calm, yet open and loving and very relaxed. When I keep sniffing my wrists after using it I feel a sort of calmly ecstatic in love feeling.

I'd say this is the real thing. It also did not cause any sensual feelings and no one was attracted to me or me to them, this just reduced anxiety and made me more accepting. I did notice however that I was hyper aware of every man in the store. So it must trigger some protective elements in the brain.

I'd recommend this to married couples who are looking to deepen their intimacy and who want to stop being irritated with each other and get along better.

I avoided anyone pregnant while wearing this as advised!

I am not a doctor nor is this review medical advice. Please consult with your doctor before using. I also don't advise using this for nefarious or deceitful purposes because the karma would not be good! Use at your own risk!

For people in love in a committed marriage relationship, this Liquid Trust can help keep you calm when needing to talk. I'd suggest both people wearing the perfume on their wrists. The scent is sort of unisex and not overly strong. Very mild really, barely noticeable.

title: Loved Two Movies!

Harvest Love is very innocent but has a little romantic dancing at a festival. I'd say it should be rated PG for this.

Pumpkin Pie Wars was really cute and I loved that the women in the movie all ended up friends again in the end. Basically you have two best friends who have a falling out and it takes years for them to even speak to each other again. The happy ending in this can't be beat! Plus lots of baking competitions and romance. A little kissing but that is it.

Truly Madly Sweetly made me feel uncomfortable for the most part because the characters were always in conflict. While the ending is happy I just felt like I would probably not watch it again. I don't mind when characters don't like each other at the start, but to be fighting for different goals basically the whole movie was not as enjoyable to watch. I also wondered what would really happen in their circumstance if the ex wife decided she wanted her husband back. It all felt a bit too risky for me.

But no violence, swearing or anything objectionable in any of the movies. The G rating seems true for the last two of the movies at least. PG for Harvest Love.

And I must admit my big strong husband came and sat right next to me while I was watching Harvest Love. These movies are enjoyable for men to watch too. Apparently. ;)))) He watched all three. text:
Eeeeeeekkk I'm so excited about this!! I love my Dry Bar Buttercup hair dryer, but really wanted a diffuser for it because I like to scrunch my hair time to time. When I added it to my cart, it was $21 I believe. That's still cheaper than Sephora so I was going to get it but waited. SO GLAD I DID. Randomly, it dropped to $12.12!!!! Purchased immediately!!

It fits my hair dryer perfectly. But, I can tell by looking at it that my hair dryer isn't a standard size on the end so I had to purchase the Bio Ionic brand since that's who makes my hair dryer. Worth it! It says universal, but I would still take measurements to make sure it'll fit yours if it isn't a Bio Ionic brand because they are not ever all universal.

The part that attaches to your hair dryer is not a hard plastic- it is rubbery (but firm) so it slides onto your hair dryer but doesn't "click" into place. I think that's why they say it's universal because this allows for some difference in the size of your dryer. But still do your research and compare your hair dryer to the size of the Buttercup hair dryer because it fits it perfectly.

You can also twist the diffuser to open up the vents or close them to control the air flow (see pictures). There will always be air flow on the outer ring of the diffuser, but you can completely close off the center, which is nice if you don't want a ton of force.

title: Great straightening brush.
text:
I never brush my hair, because, when I do, it just becomes a very frizzy mess. I was worried this brush was going to provide the same results. I'm happy to say, I was wrong, and pleasantly surprised by how well it actually worked! This set comes with two strong clips for helping you separate your hair and a cleaning brush.

You'll need to start with clean, dry, and tangle-free ( as much as possible) hair for best results. If you want to change the temperature setting from Celsius to Fahrenheit just press down on both temperature buttons at the same time. Also, They have temperature recommendations based on hair types; 410°F-446°F (210°C~230°C) for fine hair.
374°F-410°F (190°C~210°C) for normal hair.
338°F-392°F (170°C~200°C) for soft hair.

What I really like about this brush:
1. It gives my hair a more natural-looking straight hair versus my flat iron.
2. It's very easy to use.
3. The bristles are very long which keeps the heating element away from your fragile scalp. I never felt my head get hot while using it.
4. I could safely and easily use this brush on my oldest daughter to tame her hair craziness. I wouldn't say that about my flat iron.
5. This brush would work for most hair types. My underneath layers of my hair are very thick, coarse, and extremely curly while the top layer is thinner, and just wavy.

My dislikes:
1. The control buttons are placed very inconveniently on the brush handle making it very difficult to not accidentally change setting while in use.
2. The bristles are long. This makes it safe to use, but difficult to tame those little flyaways that are very close to your head.
3. This isn't a problem for my hair, but from my use of this product I don't think it would work well for those that have spiral curls.
4. The back side of the brush also gets extremely hot; be careful!

Overall, I really like this brush and feel it is well worth it's price! I will still keep and use my flat iron for special events, but i know I will use this brush for everyday styling.

title: Pretty decent product but do your research
text:
Overall, this product isn’t horrible compared to others on the market. It is paraben-free, sulfate-free, EU Allergen free and uses minimal ingredients however it also contains alcohol, silicone and is not safe for fungal acne. After running this product through a cosmetic ingredient safety checker, it scored an 88% one the EWG Health Rating. Most popular, name-brand face lotions are around 65%-80% on the EWG Health Rating. I use the EWG (Environment Working Group) as a reference when checking products and try to stay away from the alarmist side. Only 8% of this product is considered “moderate risk” mainly polyarylamide, Fragrance (unnecessary additive; possible allergy) , alcohol denat. (Bad for dry skin, bad for sensitive skin, potentially block pores) and BHT (also found in edibles, rubber products and is banned in UK and EU due to limited research showing BHT is linked to cancer). This product is good for brightening, anti-aging and promotes wound healing. It also contains steric acid which can potentially block pores.

Keep in mind, everyone’s skin is different and what effects one person may not effect another. Learn your skin and what products work best for you. Personally, I would stay away from this product if you have very dry skin and/or sensitive skin. I have “normal” skin (no sensitivities, not overly dry or oily, limited acne, no allergies) and didn’t have any issues with this product so far. It has a light scent that isn’t overpowering but completely unnecessary (I HATE fragrance in beauty products; stick with essential oils). It absorbed nicely and didn’t leave my face feeling oily. I am giving this product 4 stars as of February 21, 2021 due to the minimal ingredients and will update this review once a larger amount of time has passed to fully understand how to works with my skin.

Since this is organic I was not surprise to find this, but disappointed that it seemed to take so much shampoo. I LOVE how the shampoo smells and how it looks when I've finished blow drying and styling my hair. My hair is quite thick and can get kind of frizzy and have fly aways which did not happen with this shampoo. Typically I cannot wash my hair everyday, as it usually takes a couple days for my hair to "fall" and not look so "big". Fortunately, my hair looked great immediately with this new shampoo. I also washed my hair before a house party for New Years and had MANY compliments from various family members over the wonderful smell of my shampoo. Several requests were made by my mom, sister, sister in law and niece to tell them the name of my shampoo. It has a fresh spa like scent and appears to be a cross between a bit of honey and vanilla in the fragrance. I LOVE this shampoo and was very excited to have the opportunity to review this product for my unbiased opinion.

title: I'm a dude and these are pretty good
text:
I don't know anything about the other reviews that talk about the original Salux from Japan versus impostors from China. I've never owned a product like this before. I am male and have sensitive skin that's prone to irritation that results in random pores getting clogged on my arms or chest or legs. I've only had them for a few days, and can't really say yet if they've done anything for my pores or not, but they do seem to be doing a really good job at exfoliating my skin.

The individual towels are roughly 12 inches wide by 24 or 30 inches long. They're made of some sort of woven nylon or plastic material that is kind of wavy and extremely abrasive when rubbed across the skin. You use the towel by putting a dollop of liquid soap onto it and then rubbing it onto your body to create a lather. The towel is long enough that you can easily scrub your back by holding the ends of the towel and pulling back and forth. The towels are abrasive enough that it really feels like you're scraping a layer of skin off. Probably not appropriate for use anywhere sensitive.

I'm loving these so far. Highly recommended.

title: good budget value tooth care kit for single people, but absolutely no fancy features or extras
text:
For the price, this is an excellent basic electric toothbrush and flosser. The two pieces lack the fancy features of more expensive pieces, but my dentist says all those extra features are not worth the money. The toothbrush works great and the only feature my dentist recommends is the 2 minute timer to make sure you give yourself enough time to brush all your teeth. I've always used string floss in the past, but this water flosser seems to work just as well most of the time. Sometimes there is some food stuck in my teeth that I still have to use the string for.

As I said, features are minimal. There is 1 charger for both devices, so you can't use the charger as a stand for both items. Instead of all the cardboard in the box, why not include a cheap plastic tray or stand? There also is no travel case, just a little cover for the toothbrush head. I would really prefer a full length hard case to be included instead of having to buy an aftermarket case that doesn't fit well. Also, you only get one tip each for both the flosser and the toothbrush and there is nowhere to easily store extras. This kit is probably designed for single people only, not couples or families.

title: Nice set
text:
"Jeff's Wife" - I got these when they were an Add-On Item for $3.99, definitely worth the price. The stamper works great, I didn't even wash it first (even though you should always wash new stampers before first use), and it's slightly (I do mean slightly) softer then other clear stampers I own.

If you're new to stamping or not familiar with clear stampers, they are more delicate than opaque ones and tear easily, so be gentle with it. Wash it with dish soap & warm water, dry with a paper towel and clean it with a lint roller or tape. Never buff it or use acetone, you'll make it cloudy defeating the purpose of a clear stamper. When picking up, ROLL GENTLY over the image if you apply too much pressure it won't pick up. When applying the image to the nail press straight down (again, with GENTLE pressure) and rock side to side or roll from side to side. Don't push the tip of the nail into it, it will tear.

All the plates stamp great, I didn't swatch every image, although plates 29 & 41 have shallow etching (in my experience this is normal for BP plates) so the thinner scraper is a nice addition. It's not as thin as the 0.5mm and not a thick as the 1mm ones I own, I'd say it's 0.75mm (I didn't get out the calipers). There are different size images, a little for every nail size. But I do wish the water marble designs were bigger, I'm not a Water Marble Witch yet. Plate 52 is great for lead lighting or Sharpie water coloring.

The stamping guide works like it's supposed to, I've added a photo to show how it's used just in case it's confusing. I have a set of 4 templates from another brand already, there's not much difference in size or thickness of the metal but the designs are different. The edges aren't finished, like a plate with no backing, but I don't think it would cause anyone to slice their finger open unless you're being extremely careless.

All in all a great set.

text:
"Jeff's Wife" - This is not true to color, it dries quite a bit darker, as you can see from the pic, but since I only use it for nail art I don't care but some of you might. If you're new to nail art and want to use this for that, I do suggest you transfer some to an empty polish bottle (cleaned with acetone or brand new doesn't matter) using a syringe with some sort of tip, an eye dropper or even a straw, this will keep the large bottle from drying out. This 4 oz bottle will last you a very long time, I still have about half the bottle I bought in Feb. 2015, and costs a fraction of the price as those other brands marketed specifically for nail art.

title: interesting...
text:
I wasn't really sure what dermaplaning involved before I ordered this product. I watched a couple of youtube clips and decided to give it a try. These tools are bladed scrapers that are used to gently scrape away dead skin and tiny hairs to give your face a fresh, clean, healthy look. In the videos I watched, there was a considerable amount of icky skin removed- literally piles of it! My experience has been much less dramatic. A whole face application resulted in just a tiny amount of "dust" to be removed. I applied a bit too much pressure at first and gave myself a little scratch, so do be cautious. These blades are sharp!
I feel that my skin does look brighter and more healthy. Those videos of dermaplaning likely feature models who had been tanning and not washing their faces so the dirt and oil really built up, and skin was ready to peel.
This product removes tiny "peach fuzz" hairs but I also tried it on a small patch of coarser leg hair that I had missed while shaving. It took it off neatly with no irritation.

title: Expensive Machines
text:
The NuDerma wand has done a lot for my aging skin. There are a few creams and sera I swear by -> modern science is pretty cool. It used to be that anything topical just sat on your skin doing nothing (except the one with the french name and gazillion dollar price tag - which, btw, you can get much cheaper in the blue german tin plus seaweed serum). Anyhoo - enter the era of home treatments. Thermal machines are great if you have the money, and for less (but still not cheap) you can get these wands that are practically miraculous.

Used correctly and alongside good skincare practices, they can clear acne, minimize lines, and restore an awful lot of tone and some volume to aging skin. They don't work for everyone, but my skin is thin from prednisone use and it's aging, and the NuDerma wand has been great at firming and plumping over time.

Mine came with the red wands, and I wanted to try the blue on my kid's pizza face. Did I mention that these things zap you?

Yeah, that's important. They zap you. You want to get some numbing cream. Anyway, he's never going to let me do this again, but it's too bad because it cleared his skin beautifully. And fast. And no giant pores from popping stuff. And because they are combination wands, I can use them on my skin.

All for a very affordable amount.

title: Differentiating
text:

This cream has an excellent formula of retinol, moisturizers, and antioxidants. What it also has that many others don't is a pump that keeps air and light from destroying the ingredients. It's 3% retinol, which is pretty strong, so patch test.

Recommend.

While it's gentle in that it's not using coarse particles, I didn't enjoy the dry rubbing and tugging at my skin. You can only avoid that over 2 minutes by applying a generous amount of gel, but it's a small tube. My skin looked a little brightened afterwards but not as soft and bright as many other exfoliators (scrubs, peels, masks, serums, etc). This is $12.99, which doesn't seem like as great of a value after seeing how much you need to use. I didn't like the application, results, or price enough to reorder this.

With this, you can see the glitter speck here, the glitter speck there, the glitter speck falling a little outside your lip line that will probably end up somewhere else on your face. It has more of a youthful, party feel. I agree it's a color reminiscent of sunsets, suited for summer and fall. The case is possibly the most sophisticated I own though. It has a nice weight, and the magnetic closure feels good. It came in a box and in a sealed bag. I don't mind wearing this color, but I wouldn't buy it again. text: I needed a brush for my cats because the one I've been using removes almost too much hair and hurts my one cat plus it's uncomfortable to hold. The brushes I've been seeing look flimsy and painful with their wire tips. I liked the rubber tips on this so took the chance. It's working great so far. I can tell it doesn't hurt my cat...although she still doesn't love what's happening. It smoothed their hair without pulling it all out. The bristles kept their shape. The button pushed all the hair up, so I could cleanly and easily pull it all off. It's more comfortable to hold, and the cover is actually helpful to keep the bristles clean and protected from being bent. It's a little large for even my large cats but totally doable. It would definitely work for larger dogs as well. The price is reasonable and considering so many other similar brushes received poor reviews, I'm especially happy with this for the price.

title: Best hairdye ever
text:
Hands down best hair dye ever, and I've tried a bunch of brands. It lasts the longest and has the most vibrant colors.
It smells like cherries and has the consistency of something like cold cream.
For best results I bleach my hair to at least a medium blonde, although it is best practice to bleach as light as you can go. Don't even try it with black hair, it won't show at all.
I wash my hair once a week and the vividness last at least a month if using sulfate-free shampoo and cold water. Thereafter the color starts to fade into a lighter and less saturated tone, but still pretty. Since my hair is damaged by the bleach, the dye stains my hair and it settles to it's final color in about 4 months.
The dye helps smooth out my hair considerably after a damaging bleaching session.
I only wish they had more colors and jared versions since getting it out of the bottle is a pain when you reach the bottom. This stuff also stains your furniture and bedding (dark colors moreso than others)
Attached are photos of my hair freshly dyed shocking blue, and after a few months.

text: I did not purchase this on Amazon, but purchased at a local store because I wanted to physically view it first.  I have a bathroom with a sink under a large window. title: This is nice oil. Works very well as a beard oil.
text:
I have a big fluffy beard. Unfortunately in the winter, it more resembles a brillo pad in texture and I sometimes look like a homeless person.

This oil works well to condition and treat your beard, and the skin underneath. I apply it right out of the shower after towel drying my beard while it is still damp. I use three squirts of oil, placed in my palm, run my hands together and massage into my beard. It keeps my beard soft and supple all day, and treats the skin underneath to stop dryness and itching.

I almost thought of trimming my magnificent beard down because it was so rough, and it was itchy, this is allowing me to continue to grow it.

My beard hair is soft, manageable, and free of knots.

The glass bottle is heavy duty, so you can take it when you travel.

My ONLY complaint is the cost. It's pretty expensive, but I think a bottle would last you 2 months or so, but it's still a pretty hefty price to pay for a soft and manageable beard, free of itchiness.

title: Great hair cutter, easy to use.
text:
My wife is a professional hair stylist. She cuts my hair every 2-3 weeks and relies heavily on using electric shears to do so. This unit works very well. It can work plugged in, or with battery, which should give you about 40 minutes of time per charge.

The shears are sharp and do a great job of cutting through my thick hair. The attachments are also very nice. Unlike other units that have 6 or 7 different guards depending on what you want to do. It has a fixed length one, a short variable one, and a long variable one. For my hair she used the short variable one. The settings go from 1/16 of a inch up to about 3/4 inch, and the long variable one goes up from there.

Having the variable length guards is great as it reduces the number of guards you need and allows you to change lengths on the fly.

Using the shears without the guard is also good for trimming to the skinline, edging and shaping.

The only complaint my wife had is that she wishes it were a little more powerful on battery, but wasn't really lacking in power, it is just that she usually uses professional shears. This unit is actually as powerful or more powerful than most shears you buy at walmart or the like.

Overall a great shear for home hair cutting.

title: A great way to trim your beard!
text:
This is a great way to trim your beard. A definite step up from traditional trimmers. The magic in it is the vacuum that captures and stores trimmed beard and mustache hair instead of letting it fall into your sink to make a mess. You don't make your lady mad, and everyone is happy.

The trimmer itself fits comfortably in your hand. It has an detachable cord that allows the unit to be charged. It can operate on the cord or off it's batteries for cordless use. The trimmer is NOT submersible.

The attached guard can be adjusted to 9 length settings with a rotating selector. It can also be taken off for trimming necklines or other areas. There is also a separate smaller attachment that can be used for precision cuts.

The vacuum is power and made more powerful over earlier models through the use of the "Turbo" button that amps up the cutting power and vacuum power substantially. When you are done cutting your hairs are captured in a removable tray for disposal. There are still a few hairs that don't get sucked up but it a huge improvement over using trimmers without suction.

The only negatives are that the hair capture cup is a tad small. There is also a plastic piece that guides hair into the cup that makes neck and cheek-line trimming a little tricky until you get the hang of it.

Overall a great trimmer for those of us real men with beards. A must have!!

title: The BEST for preventive maintenance &repair of your skin
text:
Quickly approaching (a still, sadly, rather vain) age 40, I have personally spent a small fortune over the years trying to slow the aging process and reverse the effects of too many days spent gardening without sunscreen. I cannot even begin to list all the products I've somewhat foolishly gambled on to get my skin looking better. This product--and several other products offered through the company NEOTERIC (all under the Alpha Hydrox brand)--are exactly the answer I've been looking for. I've used them both alone and in conjunction with a more expensive brand of anti-aging products (for which I've also left good reviews on this site), and I can see great improvements both ways.

I decided to try this brand of alpha hydroxy cream after reading in Dr. Oz's (and Dr. Roizen's) book [[ASIN:0743292561 You: Staying Young: The Owner's Manual for Extending Your Warranty (You)]]. I'd tried several other alpha hydroxy products before this one (i.e. ROC, etc.) and must say this particular line (ALPHA HYDROX) is far superior to any other I've used. That it is also apparently considerably less expensive than most is icing on the cake, in my book.

Regarding this product, I find the key is to use it AT LEAST once a day, and always after using a mild cleanser. At my age I still get acne and, despite my sometimes manic picking, I notice it (and any residual puffiness or redness, and resulting scarring) clears up much, much more quickly than it used to. Also, my skin breaks out much less than before I used this. The tone and color of my skin are far improved when compared to prior to using this product. I've run out of it before and tried to use something else until I was able to locate more locally, and to my dismay the condition of my skin began to deteriorate.

I won't try to insult anyone by saying the Alpha Hydrox line will remove every wrinkle or fix all your skincare woes. If there is a product out there that does this, I want to know! But for now, this is by far the best line of products I've used. I use this item, particularly, with the line of skincare I reviewed previously, as that seems to address reversing the signs of aging better (where this one, for me, just improves the overall condition and appearance of my skin).

title: Nice grooming set
text:
My husband used this kit and took, when asked to do a bit of a review on it for me, took it very seriously. The price isn't cheap so he wanted to make sure to really look at everything as he used it. Here is what he had to say:

"You have a pack of accessories here so I thought I would run through them in turn to tell you what you are getting and my impression of it

Shampoo and body wash.
Okay, I ran through this way too quick and used all of it. It's good. It's really good and I couldn't really get enough of it. So that's a plus and a negative in that there isn't really a lot of it to begin with.

Face wash.
I love to get In there and give my face a right good scrubbing. This helps. The wash is thick and gel like with the exfoliating, and it does feel like you have given your face a good scrub after use. You do feel cleaner after use.

Shave cream
I'm not one for using cream very often. I prefer basic foam from a can. But wow. This stuff leaves your face feeling clean and fresh after shaving. Not only that but incredibly soft.

Moisture cream
This is really not something I use at all. I would think it best to use after shaving because you are stripping moisture from your face, but in that regard the shave cream is sufficient. I just don't personally have a need for a separate moisture cream. So it is sort of hard to form an opinion about it.
What I can tell you is that it doesn't really have a scent, my face does feel super soft. On the downside it is a little messy and I found myself wiping away the excess.

For the most part then I really like this set. It comes in a handy pouch you can use long after the accessories are empty. However, that won't take too long because the bottles are very small. It's something for people who aren't concerned about the cost. It's very expensive. Is it worth the cost for me? Not really. Not in terms of either quality or quantity but if the price was lower I would be recommending to everyone."

There you go guys and gals. That's what he thought about the set. He's still talking about it so he did like it, just thought it was a bit much.

title: Great shampoo and conditioner!
text:

The conditioning was just not quite enough on the ends of my hair. Great on the already healthy stuff, just seemed to ignore the drier ends. This really gave my hair a nice shine to it. My hair is getting old with me and it no longer wants to be as manageable and tame as it once was. With this duo of delight my hair looked healthy after it dried. It looked good when left to air dry, when dried with the hot air brush, and when left to air dry. It looked shiny without the added matching shine spray (which is also a wonderful product) and with. I left out the word smooth in this so far but let me tell you! It was also smooth and sleek without having to use other products to make it stay that way. Granted, under all that grey old hair there has always been fairly thin straight hair so this just really put it back to looking like it used to in that regard. The shampoo cleaned it to the point of being squeaky clean as well.
Give this duet a try if you can. It works really well and smells alright to boot!

title: Probably works well depending on your skin type

"So like many people i have been wearing a mask all day. It's hot and it becomes humid under the mask. Perfect breeding place for acne. It was forming all around my mouth. I'm not going to complain about it. Just that's how it is now, and we have to work with it.
This serum seemed to be working at first. It's easy to apply using the dropper. Just squeeze a few drops on to the affected area and let it dry in.
You will notice when you use it that your skin appears to be tightening. Also with continued use the red marks on your face will lighten and eventually fade.
I had to stop using it. I believe it was working at first but after some continued use it was making things worse and the acne was spreading. I have a slightly oily skin type and this may not have been best suited to me.
Glad I tried it and I have a feeling that it may work better for a different skin type than mine."

There you have it. That's what he thought about it.

title: Suited More for 6+ and Older
text:
A few things here …

LES ENFANTS is French for CHILDREN

It doesn’t refer to infants or toddlers. For those who don’t know, a quick note …

Newborn – birth to 4 weeks
Infants – 4 weeks to 1 year
Toddler – 1-3
Preschooler – 3-5
Child – 6-13

That said …

It does state NOT TO SPRAY IT ON A BABY’S SKIN. “Applying gently on clothes” is the preferred method. Though to be honest, I’d say this is more for ages 6+

While baby cologne isn’t something I would use on a baby, it could be better for adults who want a light scent and not overwhelmed by a perfume.

For almost $30, this is an 8.5 fl oz spray. Compared to some perfumes and colognes, this is moderately priced.

Smell? It isn’t the greatest. I do like it as a light, after-bathing scent. It seems more suited to a room freshener than a perfume. But, it isn’t the WORST perfume/scent I’ve smelled.

The generous size means it will last a while.

Would I get it again? No. Nor would I recommend it either.

💅🏻 2 – Ring fingernails
💅🏻 2 – Pinkie fingernails

I know – sounds almost silly or stupid to mention, but that’s math. Total “NAILS” needed: 10 … (“Luxury 12pcs press on nails kit comes with 10 different sizes which is pre-numbered 0-9 in a box” … “choose the most suitable size that fits you every finger”). Hard to fit every finger when the nails are different sizes.

And, we’re NOT all sized the same. Hence why some packaging is no less than 24 nails with 12 sizes. I know because I’ve bought nails like this for YEARS! Just look up KISS and you’ll see what I am talking about.

This?

Was this a joke? This is a set of TWELVE (12) nails – 10 different sizes! 🤷🏻‍♀️🤦🏻‍♀️

Unlike the model hands – I don’t wear my nails OVER the edges of my finger. That is NOT how you wear these nails to begin with – and definitely NOT with nail glue. Even being “fake”, the nails should at LEAST attempt to look realistic. See how the salons do them, look on Google (or your favorite search engine).

Who thought this was a great idea? And, these HAVE to be the LARGEST sizes for the particular “nails” I’ve seen. These really are a fancier version of the Lee and Wet N’ Wild from the late 1980’s/early 1990’.

What’s worse? Even the PACKAGING states: 24

Did they not think anyone would notice that detail?

I’ll admit, these are pretty. And, thinking it was a HALF package, I contacted Amazon for a return/replacement. I cancelled the replacement, but I am returning these. As I told the rep – they’re pretty useless as they are. There is NO way I can use these. I would, at MINIMUM, only get 4 nails worth of coverage. For this price? Nope. Not at all. And, I feel sorry for those who do have to pay.

In addition, the nearly $16 price tag (excluding sales tax) for 12 nails? Unreasonable. In my case, I’d need TWO (2) sets which would run $32. For that price – I might as well just wear a mask, go to the salon, and have them do it for me. My nails would definitely last two weeks, and I wouldn’t have to do them myself.

I will not be getting these again and DO NOT recommend them. The seller might have a better set out there, but not this selection.

title: Underwhelming Cleanser
text: This is an exfoliating facial cleanser that really didn't feel that great or give me that much in benefits. For $23 it is not something I'd get again or recommend. It was slightly overpriced and overhyped.

title: Beautiful But Need to Be Cautious When Using
text:
This is, for less than $10, a lovely comb.

Can function at a wedding or other event. However, the cons outweigh the beauty.

Given how delicate this is, there is NO storage box or bag. So, after use – where does one put it? That is an issue for me. Even a simple velvet type bag would be a good idea.

Second? The comb itself.

While absolutely stunning in design – function is a bit questionable because of the construction. The combs are “OPEN” design – thus loose hairs can weave in, particularly those with thick and curly hair. This makes removal or readjusting a bit difficult if not a tad uncomfortable.

This is also for thicker hair, not thin, and thus circles back to the issue I just presented.

While pretty, it isn’t something I am particularly pleased with. It isn’t something I would get for myself again. I also wouldn’t give it as a gift.

title: Wax On, Wax Off, Hair Still There
text:
I think a lot of us want an easier way to remove hair. Shaving, especially for a bigger girl like me, is not that easy. It’s worse when you have long legs, short arms.

It’s bad when you have certain chin hairs (thankfully not that much it isn’t manageable another way).

I tried some sugar wax kit back about 20+ years ago. That was a NIGHTMARE! It was supposedly edible. I think you microwaved the container, spread it on, let it cool, used a paper strip (supplied) to remove the hair. It didn’t work and stung.

I then moved to a hair removal cream, that partially worked.

After that? Back to the hold stand-by –> shave foam/cream and a razor. For my main body parts, that’s always worked. Tough “chin” hairs –> using a tweezer work. No, the dermaplaning tool didn’t work on them.

I got a wax warmer, so I thought all beads/beans were equal.

These came with ZERO instructions, and the after spray bottle was busted. The warmer kit at least had some. And, my warmer kit had specially made, disposable “cups”.

These beads/beans, in a smaller cup, took over 90 minute to melt. And, the warmer was on 180°(F).

I tried a small amount on my arm. The wax was sticky, not liquidy, and it cooled almost as soon as it hit my skin.

I let it sit there for a few minutes (over 5), and peeled the max off. It didn’t hurt, sting, or cause redness – then again …

THE HAIR WAS STILL THERE

Okay, so my hair on my arm is a little thin. But, if this removes thick hair, shouldn’t it remove thinner hair?

I found another patch, got some warm wax – tried it again. Nope. Tried legs, arms, and under my chin. Nothing. Then again, I see I'm not the only one experiencing issues with these beads/beans.

I may have gotten a bad batch. But, I definitely wouldn’t get these again.

title: Great for Travel
text:
As most have said here – these are great for travel, especially when you can’t find soap around but have water. Though I wouldn’t carry a bar of soap, I have used “travel” size body wash as a hand soap. If it cleans the body, should clean the hands, right?

Anyway …

The metal container I got was dented, but that is okay as I don’t intend to travel where I won’t have soap. So, I’m using these at my bathroom sink.

LET ME STATE THIS AS A WARNING: HANDS MUST BE DRY BEFORE GRABBING A SOAP SHEET.

I know all caps is yelling, but trust me – it is for a VERY GOOD reason. As one reviewer said, even a drop of water can damage these.

Basically I grab a one with dry hands, hold it in palm, turn water on, let it dissolve. Good lather, I don’t really smell a “scent”, hands wash clean. They don’t dry out, but I do use a moisturizing sanitizer, and hand lotion after.

I wouldn’t say these go years – if you’re like me and using them as an alternative to other hand soaps to preserve waste, they might last about a month (8 washes per day, 30 days). If only as travel backup – they might last a few years. Again, it depends on how they’re used.

I personally find them a bit on the pricey side at almost $10 before tax. That’s just me.

I do have other soaps, and these should last me a while. I would not recommend them as a body wash. As opposed to carrying a bar of soap, try a travel container with body wash. Just my suggestion.

title: It Slightly Works
text:
This product as a lot going for it. I love the idea of the individually gift boxed tubes, the cap is wonderful (huge and easy to use), the product is generously sized.

The problem is that this stuff is runny, doesn’t absorb that well on me, and the “scent” that is there – it isn’t that great.

For $15 before tax, that is roughly $3.75 a tube, and while they’re smaller – I’d honestly stick with Bath & Body Works.

This isn’t something I’d get again and I wouldn’t recommend it. I also wouldn’t give it as a gift.

title: Perfect Manicure Set
text:
Colorful manicure and pedicure kit for home, gym, or travel.

Has most everything needed and easy to store. Love the pretty case. Price is great as well.

Each tool is functional and works great.

title: Barely Made a Wave
text:
I have been trying, for well over 30 years, to get a curling iron that actually did what it was supposed to – curl my hair.

Hot curlers – no good results

Curling Irons (¼, ½) – no good results

Wrap-Around Fabric Curlers – nothing there

I saw this and thought it couldn’t fail. Simple to use – plug in, turn on, heat up, section hair, and use – put hair in, count down.

Works in theory, fails in execution. First up – there is NO heat seating guide for SAFE curling. THIS DEVICE IS CELSIUS (C) ONLY, NO FARENHEIT (F) OPTION. Google is strongly needed here.

According to Redken: “For those with fine or thin hair, keep your iron set below 200 (so below 100°C on this device) degrees Fahrenheit. Any higher and your strands may burn. For those with coarse or thicker hair, have your curling iron set between 200 degrees and 300 degrees (148.9°C or on this device 150) Fahrenheit for optimal curls” [9 Curling Iron Secrets You Need to Know About/Redken]

Using that, as well as Glamour’s 8-10 second rule [How to Curl Your Hair Correctly: 7 Mistakes to Avoid – Glamour; “Drill it into your brain: You should hold an iron on your hair for eight to 10 seconds max”], along with using thinner groups of hair – I should have SOME wave. Nope. I even went 25 seconds. Nothing.

As my hair has become a bit thinner, has been color treated, and exposed to SO much – I wasn’t about to turn this up hotter.

The curler is designed much like a crimper, but the “width” can make it difficult to handle, especially by yourself. There is a “guard” which heats up as well and it is easy to burn yourself.

It wins with innovative idea as well as the digital temp gauge. Also, it does heat up SUPER fast, as well as cool down just as fast when lowering the temp.

For use by myself – this is a two star deal. Perhaps if someone else were around it might be easier, but this definitely did not work well.

title: Not The Worst, But Definitely Not The Best
text:
I really wanted to LOVE this scrub – there was just too much wrong with it to even LIKE it.

First of all – this is FAR TOO THICK to squeeze out of the tube. I had to SMASH it with my arm to get it to MOVE.

The scent? If you’re looking for Bath & Body Works type of Cherry Blossom, you’re not going to get it.

Once you get it out, and can take the scent – after it is applied, it is a soft, moisturizing and no slip scrub.

This isn’t something I’d get again or recommend.

title: Gold Standard of Lamps
text:
This UV/LED lamp is by far one of the best I’ve used. I have another one by OVLUX (one of my favorites). So, when I saw this, I didn’t hesitate to get it to have on standby.

There are a few issues with it, but I’m overall pleased.

Very easy to use.

title: Not The Best Set Out There
text:
Be warned, this is NOT “dip powder”. This is indeed acrylic powder in VERY small jars.

This does not come with instructions though – at least mine didn’t. So that could make this a bit hard to work with.

The colors are pretty though.

This isn’t the best kit out there, I have seen better ones. The packaging isn’t that stable or durable. I ended up putting the jars in a pencil case.

I honestly wouldn’t get it again. As far as durability, I usually do my manicure every week or so.

title: Nail Clips
text:
I mainly got these for a “home-made” gel soak off (using foil).

And, they worked! They don’t pinch at all; even my mom used them and said she could barely feel them.

Light weight and fairly durable. There are enough for two people to use at the same time, or extras on hand if they ever break.

If used for poly gels, I’m sure they would work just as well.

title: Standard Nail Drill
text:
Pretty standard nail drill.

This is similar, if not identical to most of the nail drills used in the salon.

Best used to remove gel polishes and/or nail tips to prepare them for other polishes or plain removal.

title: Not so Starry
text:
Thank you in advance to the Amazon VINE program for providing an item to review. A positive review was not required, nor was it requested, and all words are my own.

Getting my nails done is not just a relaxing experience, but it is also an expressive/creative one.

Seeing this colorful and glittery set – I had to get it.

I don’t know about others’ experiences – mine did not come with a brush or applicator for the little “gel pots”. I remembered what my nail techs used to use – small make-up brushes – and thankfully I had some. That seemed to work.

The black polish is necessary to get the desired effect. I chose the purple glitter gel and after a few awkward moments – I got a pretty decent manicure. More of the black showed through, there were moments when the purple glitter reflected, but it wasn’t what I thought.

I haven’t tried the other colors. But, this is fairly decent and easy to use. Not my favorite as there are other brands out there that are even easier to use.

Overall, I’m not too unhappy with it. It’s not something I would likely purchase again.

title: cute
text: i have long, very thick hair as all my daughters do too and we like to keep our hair up most of the time.  I have many many clips and most of them are not good.  I always break the spring in the clip or one of the teeth.  These are metal and a cute design and not too heavy.  They grab the hair and then they really don't move.  No sliding down, or shifting around,.  They are easy to grip, open and place in the hair.  They do open nice and wide too. What i like is that the teeth meet under the hair.  when you have thick hair, sometimes the clips don't close around the hair tightly becuase the spring is too weak.  this has a nice strong spring so it snaps back closed and around the hair and holds it in place.

title: Bigger than expected and super cute
text:
***I received this item for free on the condition I provide an honest review****
First, this bag is BIG! But not too big. If you see the photos, it's bigger than the 16.9 ounce water bottle. It has a easy to use zipper with no rough spots. The embellishments are nicely done and affixed snuggly. The material is soft but sturdy and the shade of pink is fabulous.
This would be ideal for travel or everyday in a larger tote.
Great price point!

title: Hydrates and protects
text: This is a gentle and hydrating mask. Even though it has a retinol alternative, you can use it over a stronger serum. This is almost like a sleep mask, not all of it absorbs, it keeps a protective layer on your face while you sleep. It really hydrates so you look rested even if you aren’t.

title: hard to squeeze out
text: I love the smell of this and is is very hydrating. The only issue is that it is so thick that it is hard to squeeze it out from the bottle. You need 2 strong hands to get it out. This is definitely annoying.

title: Fabulous
text: This is great eye cream, it hydrates and erases fine lines. It even gives a bit of a glow and looks great under makeup. The cream is thick and rich, one of the best I’ve ever used. And it will last a long time!

title: Great mask
text:
Thin Bamboo Sheet Sap infused sheet facee masks with rice essence extract cream for intensive moisturizing for pore reduction for all skin types, product made in Korea
The Power of Rice, for Your Skin care : With an innovative delivery system, this Korean Rice Cream Topping facial mask sheet actively works to deliver the skin enhancing power of our proprietary hydrating Rice Extract Cream faster and deeper to restore suppleness and moisture.
This is a pretty neat idea for a mask. The mask is soaked in serum, you put this on and then you add the rice cream on top so it soaks into your skin after the serum does. It’s quite hydrating and soothing.

title: Great skincare line
text:
I really like this line. I see improvements using the exfoliating scrub, the toning serum and my favorite is the hydra-whipped moisturizer. The scrub and the serum are also sold separately in full size bottles but the hydra-whipped is not and I'm so hoping it will be in the future. It absorbs without a trace of residue and the benefits are long lasting.
The only thing that did not wow me was the eye cream. It is pretty basic, offers some hydration.

title: Works quite well
text: I’ve never tried anything like this product before. You put it on, wait 5 minutes and then wash your face with it. Over time it really does make my skin look clearer and brighter. I don’t use this daily, just a couple times a week. It could be used daily though but it is kind of expensive.

title: Great for your skin
text: Omg these are wonderful. I used to rub ice over my face in the morning years ago. This is much better. It’s nice to have 4 to keto cold but I have not had to use more than one at a time. They stay cold for with a while. When it feels like it isn’t cold, I roll it a little with my finger and then it’s fine. This is a fantastic tool to use in the morning especially if you have puffy eyes. I like using it before I put on make up. At night I will sometimes use it after I put my serums  and moisturizer on. It’s very relaxing.

title: Gentle but effective
text: This isn’t the strongest vitamin c cream I’ve used but it is better than most serums. I seem to see better results with lotions like this. I’m not sure if the lemon adds anything, the aloe might be why I can use this daily without irritation. It is gentle enough for day use though you might want to use sunscreen with it.

title: Love this, so hydrating!!
text: I love this mask. It is very hydrating and the mask is thicker than most and clings very well.  The benefits last much longer than others I have used. This is by far one of my favorite masks and it’sa good deal for the price.

title: Yummy scent
text: Although I wish this body wash was more sudsy, it smells delightful, a nice burst of sunshine in winter. It is hydrating but not enough for dry winter, it’s probably going to be fine on summer months. The scent really is luscious!

title: Gentle retinol serum
text: This retina serum, more like a cream, is very gentle so if this isn’t something you normally use due to redness or sensitivity this might be a good product for you. Results will be much slower but you won’t have peeling skin or dryness. This is also hydrating so it’ss good mix of ingredients to make it perfect for sensitive skin. It works well but I’m not noticing any brightness to my skin.

title: So hydrating
text: I love this mask almost as much as an avocado sheet mask I have. It really hydrates your skin and it is so soothing. I’ll be buying more of these for certain. I used this after a chemical peel that I use and it really took care of the usual redness I get.

title: Hydrating
text: This is one of the better HA products that I’ve used. It’s great for keeping my skin hydrated all day and hiding fine lines. Can be used at night and in the morning under make up.

title: What a relief!
text: I don’t know about you but I have been having dry hands from lots of hand sanitizer. And my poor cuticles. This hand cream is very rich and hydrating without leaving any greasy residue or taking forever to absorb. This is excellent quality hand cream and my hands are getting better. I only need to use it once or twice a day.

title: Works well, a bit too tingly
text: I just recently started using the paper charcoal bubble masks but I do love peel off masks even more. I put on a medium layer of this and after a few minutes it starts to bubble. Unlike with the paper masks it was almost too tingly that made me want to just wash it off. But it went away after a few more minutes and then I just had to wait for it to dry. Maybe 20 minutes total. I like to leave peel off masks on longer to tighten my pores. It came of in just a couple pieces which was unusual, usually you have all these scraps left on. My skin looked and felt very fresh after.

title: Hydrating and light
text: This is a very hydrating gel-cream moisturizer. It’s light and absorbs well.  It lasts all day, I think it is perfect for morning use under makeup. I like the green color too. It’s almost as good as Moisture Surge, better than the similar gel cream by Neutrogena. I’d definitely use this on an ongoing basis. Highly recommend!

title: Foamy and cleansing
text: These bubble masks are so fun. I like the tingly way they feel while they get all foamy. My face feels super clean afterwords and brighter. It feels messy but it isn’t really, I didn’t get anything on my clothes. This is perfect for the end of a long week when your pores feel clogged. I don’t know if there is any long term benefits but I like them.

title: Very Small but nice
text: This is a small oil diffuser than others I have seen or used but it is very nice and looks better in person than in pictures. The light design is nice but too much for me when I’m sleeping. You have to turn off the whole thing to turn the lights off. You can turn on the diffuser without lights but once on I can only get them off by turning off the diffuser. It lasts almost through the night maybe 6 hours? I find taking off the ceramic cover easier than covers of other diffusers. I use this for just my bedroom so it is perfect. I did not come with a measuring cup for water, this is unusual but I had an extra so no big deal.

title: Waste of money
text:
I'm disappointed. Mostly in myself as I should have read the ingredient list carefully. This is just a glycerin soap with chemicals and a negligent amount of honey and lots of heavy perfume. It's a bit drying for my face. I will probably finish this as a hand soap.
I'm going to continue to look for a better, more natural honey soap.

title: Happily, this one did not
text:
I have difficulty with serums as they tend to cause breakouts. Happily, this one did not. Maybe because there is almond oil in it, my skin does very well with that. I haven't noticed a reduction in wrinkles but this is gentle enough to use around my eyes. This makes my skin smoother for applying makeup in the morning and the serum isn't greasy at all.
I really like that this isn't tested on animals and I think the price is decent. Time will tell if this makes me look younger.

title: absobs quickly, not greasy
text: I have always loved this oil but I haven't used it in years, I thought it had been discontinued. I was given a bottle of the lightly scented version to review. I can be sensitive to some scented products, they can give me headaches. This one is light enough to not bother me at all. Because the weather has been so warm, I add peppermint oil when I use this. It is refreshing and cooling. I am a big fan of using oils to moisturize my skin, though than can be greasy. What I like about this oil is that it absorbs quickly so I can get dressed right away if need be. I usually just towel off to slightly damp skin then use this oil and air dry. It really makes my skin soft and smooth. I'm glad this oil is still around. When I run out, I will definitely buy more.

title: Great for the price!!
text: The perfect addition to your day time routine. N3 No Name can serve as a perfect and easy to apply primer. The scent is light and pleasant. The finish is fresh and smooth.

title: Stayed sticky for 15 minutes
text:
The Multivitamin Sleeping Mask by Vitamasques is made in Korea. The tube has a foil safety seal under the cap.

I liked the concept of a face mask I could wear to bed. I’m not as good as I should be at keeping to a proper skincare routine. So I thought this sleeping mask would be great. Put it on before bed and wake up with a hydrated, healthier face.

The directions say “Apply a generous layer before you sleep or whenever your skin needs a nourishing boost.” I started with a small pea-sized drop, which was enough for my whole face.

The mask has a gel consistency and goes on clear. But it did not absorb into my skin. After fifteen minutes, my face was still sticky and tacky. No way would I go to sleep like that, my face would stick to the pillow.

So I washed the mask off, which was a disappointment since it’s supposed to be a “non-wash off mask.” My skin was a little softer, but having to wash my face because it was still sticky defeats the purpose of a mask that I’m supposed to be able to wear to sleep.

title: Gentle effectie cleanser, made in Korea
text:
This jelly facial cleanser from Vitamasques is made in Korea.

The tube has a foil safety seal under the white cap. The cleanser is brown with a jelly-like consistency. It does have a scent, a mix of green tea and tea tree oil. I do notice the scent when using the cleanser but the scent doesn’t linger.

A small drop is enough to wash my face and neck. It doesn’t make a lot of lather but does feel silky going on the skin. I really like the consistency of it.

And I really like how well the cleanser works! It cleaned two layers of sunscreen grime and sweat off my face. Some face washes don’t remove all the sunscreen residue, and I have to keep washing my face or use an exfoliating scrub. This cleanser? One wash and done. I was amazed by how well it worked.

I’m in my 30s, white, with sensitive combination skin. The cleanser did not irritate my face at all.

title: Cute and functional
text:
If I have a choice between a plain headband and a unicorn headband, well, I’m picking the unicorn headband every time!

These headbands are super cute and colorful. The faux fur is soft and doesn’t shed, and really adds to the unicorn aspect. The horns stand up from the headband, and are sparkly silver. The ears don’t stand up as well, they’re a bit floppy, and also have sparkly silver on the backs.

The headbands are on the smaller side. I measured approximately 6 inches across the opening with a headband unstretched, and about 9 inches when fully stretched. I like that the headbands are tight, they stay on my head and hold my hair back. I don’t have to keep fussing with them, they stay in place. They are about 2½ inches wide, which helps with comfort.

title: One side works, but that's all I need
text:
I like one side of this Silicone Back Scrubber from Lnlofen. The “soft brush” side, the one with the longer bristles, works great for scrubbing my back. I can actually feel the bristles move against my skin, and so I feel like I’m getting clean.

The other side, the “stiff brush” side, just slid right over my skin. I didn’t feel the bumps at all.

I’m 5’5” and slender, the back scrubber is long enough for me.

The package includes a hook to hang the brush in the shower, but I just loop it over the shower rail and it dries quickly. The brush can roll up into a compact bundle for storage.

title: Great files
text:
This pack of 16 nail files from Keiby Citom is a great value.

I started doing dip nails at home, and the worst part is getting off the old manicure. I have to file off the layers of top coat, which can take a while if I don’t have a good file. I prefer a glass file for actually shaping my nails, but they’re not good for removing layers of polish.

Using one of these files, I had the top coat filed off all my nails in less than ten minutes. The 100 grit side is perfect. I actually asked a nail tech friend what I should use, and she told me 100 grit.

The files come in a zipper seal plastic bag that can be used to store them.

The edges of the files aren’t sharp. I’m talking about the edges that touch your skin; sometimes these can be sharp, especially on pro files, and need to be seasoned to prevent cuts. No problems with that here.

title: Looks cool and works well
text:
The look of the Lassie hair dryer is what caught my eye first. It just looks cool! I have the PinkGray color. The gray is a medium shade with a smooth finish that won’t pick up hairs and dust. The pink is a metallic magenta that really pops.

The speed controls are on the handle. The slide button doesn’t move easily, so there’s not a big chance of accidentally changing the speed/temperature without meaning to. On the back of the handle is the option for either cool or hot temperature.

The hair dryer doesn’t dry my hair any faster than any other hair dryer I’ve used. But I like that I can set the temperature to cool to lessen damage and not have to hold in a cool shot button.

The hair dryer isn’t as lightweight as some plastic models I’ve used, but it’s weighted pretty well. The weight of it is distributed evenly on both sides of the handle.

The attachments have little tabs that line up with notches on the nozzle, and then you twist them to lock them in place. I like it -- there’s less chance of them popping off while I use the hair dryer.

The bottom of the hair dryer says the rated power is 1800 watt, which is contrary to the description which says it is 2000 watt.

title: Very strong
text:
I tried the Cedarwood Essential Oil from Sweetvally. The oil is so strong that I smelled it even before removing it from the box or breaking the seal on the bottle. The bottle is tiny but mighty, I guess!
