title: ***READ HERE FIRST!  TERRIBLE REPLACEMENT!***
text:
If you've been reading any of the reviews here lately you will know the 8000 series foil/cutterblock combo has been replaced with a new combo now called the series 5 Combi 51S. You will receive this replacement even if the picture on the product page shows "8000 series" as it has been discontinued for over a year. Braun merged the replacement for the 8000 series (Activator) with the 360 Complete. This new foil/cutterblock is garbage! The cutterblock has wide blades, as opposed to the thinner blades of the original 8000 series, which pull your stubble and take MANY passes over your face to shave. They are prone to premature failure and I have gone through 3(THREE) of these in 6 months! (I bought one and two were free through Braun after complaining). All the free replacements in the world weren't making the shaving experience any better. I longed for the days when my Activator 8595 cut smooth, close, and comfortably. After all, this shaver had been my favorite for 6 years so far! I was very close to dumping the whole shaver and moving on when I happened across a reviewer on Amazon who suggested using the 7000 series replacement foil/cutterblock in his review. It worked PERFECTLY! The 7000 series replacement looks just like the much coveted original on my 8595 Activator - down to the thinner cutting blades! It didn't pull my stubble, it cut smooth as butter, and was comfortable: JUST LIKE NEW! I'd like to thank the original reviewer (James L. Walls "sixtoe") for the very good advice.

***Update: August 10th, 2011***
I hope people are happy with the replacement I recommended. I sure am! I just wanted to update the product link for the better replacement: [[ASIN:B001VH6F9G Braun Series 3 Combi 30B Foil and Cutter Replacement Pack (Formerly 4700,7000)]]

***Update: January 13, 2013***
Unfortunately, the Braun 30B Foil and Cutter Replacement Pack is now the same terrible cutter block design as the series 5 (8000 replacement). I ordered another 30B to replace the one I bought 2.5 years ago and was highly disappointed when the package came. I will have to do some research to see if any of Braun's other replacements are the good, narrow blade versions. I have read some reports that the narrow cutting block is available, but without the foil. If I cannot find a narrow blade replacement I am going to throw in the towel after 8 years of service from this shaver. Shame on Braun for putting out those ill performing wide blade cutting blocks. Terrible...

***Update: January 18, 2013***

It appears the highly elusive narrow blade cutter block can be found on the 31S replacement pack. The unfortunate news is the included foil is not compatible. Therefore, a replacement foil for the 8000 series/Activator/7000 series/360 Complete would be needed in conjunction with the quality cutter block effectively doubling your cost because it is difficult to find the foil sold by itself. This would be a combined expense of roughly $55-$60 in order to bring your shaver back to the "like new" shave we all want. Remember - the "direct" replacement combo for this shaver series will leave you highly disappointed due to the WIDE cutter block which pulls hair and easily nicks skin. Another facet to influence your decision in spending $60 to refresh your Braun is many of these shavers - due to their age - are in need of new motors and potentially batteries. The motors gradually slow down with time and I noticed a HUGE difference when I replaced mine 2 years ago. Now, these motors are almost impossible to find at this point and for me, personally, it is getting to the point of diminished returns. I hope this post helps you in both informing you of the available narrow cutter block, but also in weighing your decision in either keeping your Braun chugging along or researching a new alternative.

text:
I was gifted this charging dock and have been using it for around 2 years so I thought I'd chime in. For starters, I didn't like the fact that I couldn't charge my phone when it was in a case so I didn't use it much originally, however, after I bought a 2nd and 3rd LG OEM battery (one of which came with a charging cradle case) I've been using it a lot more.

Although a bit tight, if you plug the charging cradle case into the phone dock cradle, you can actually charge two batteries at once (the 2nd battery goes into the charging port in the rear). Since my phone is typically connected to a Quickcharge 3.0 charger, this allows me to charge all three batteries simultaneously, which is a huge win in my book.

I have this charger dock cradle plugged into a USB hub, so it trickle charges my batteries at 1.5A, extending life by conditioning them. This is quite the contrary to my QC 3.0 charger which, as time has shown, is quite brutal on my lithium batteries and has drastically shortened their life span / capacity.

Everyone's usage and configuration is slightly different, but for my needs this cradle has become exactly what I needed. Hopefully my setup helps alleviate some of your annoyances that I first experienced with this product as well.

text:
I had pretty high hopes when purchasing this shampoo, especially after reading all the glowing reviews. Over the past year, I've actively been reducing the number of chemicals in our household and have saved body care for last as I struggle to find things that work as well as mainstream ones. Pretty bummed to say this but I'm adding this to the list of products I've not been a fan of.

The bad - While soft, it almost gives my hair too much volume or something? (I have fine hair but a lot of it.) Thought it was just my hair at first but this only happens when using this shampoo. Finally, the bottle that was sent ended up having some weird manufacturing defect where the top wont stay shut. It now has to sit upside down which is kind of a pain considering the design of the shampoo bottle doesn't easily allow for that. I'm constantly scared it will tip and spill, and this stuff is far too expensive to waste!

EDITED: Wanted to return to add that I've recently been using this product consistently and my hair has never felt healthier. Maybe it just took some time for my hair to get used to? Not sure if it's due to this shampoo, the supplements I recently added, or what in particular but I am starting to really love it. Only left one star off for the minor annoyance of product defect. Fingers crossed that won't happen next time.

text:
Nice quality nail polish and healthier for my nails!

I have a mild case of toenail fungus and wanted to cover up so I can wear open-toed shoes for summer, without making my case worse.

Previously I had painted my toenails with Essie nail polish and removed it only to discover the fungus had gotten much worse. I painted my toenails with the Dr. Remedy’s polish, left it on for just over a week and removed it to check on my nail health. The nail is continuing to grow out healthy. Keep in mind if you’re getting it for this reason, I’ve been continuing to apply treatment under and around the nail while wearing the polish. (Tea tree oil and Vick’s vapor rub, apple cider vinegar soak a couple of times a week.) I see myself buying this polish in other colors and continuing to use it even once my fungus has fully grown out to continue to protect my nail health.

Before purchasing I read reviews about issues with the consistency, durability and coverage of the polish. I ordered the clear coat and precious pink and found that they applied, dried, covered and wore similar to OPI polishes I’ve had in the past. The precious pink is a nice light pink, I applied two coats to my little coats and three coats to my big toes to get even coverage, which I would expect of any light colored polish. The color was opaque for me after applying this way.

title: Using it for nail art
text:
I bought this for nail art as a peel-off skin barrier.
My cuticles are so much happier since this latex protects them from polish mess which means no harsh acetone clean-up every day... and I am happy that I don't need to add an extra 30 minutes to my nail art routine.

- The 4oz tub will last me quite a while. I've used it so many times and it still looks full. Obviously a body paint artist will use more but 4oz is still a good size and this is a good price.
- It's extremely easy to use with no learning curve. Just brush/swipe/dab it on... it turns dark as it dries... peel off when done. No clean-up at all since it peels cleanly.
- It dries pretty quickly and doesn't start peeling/lifting until I want it to.
- Nail artists are probably familiar with teeny tiny bottles of peel-off skin barriers. They're great but so is this at a tiny fraction of the cost. The only difference is that this doesn't come with a brush.

I realllllly love this stuff and I reallllllly love that I didn't spend this same amount on a bottle that's labelled for nail art but 15 times smaller!

title: Very complete set
text:
I'm very into nail art so this was one of the coolest things I've tried out in a while!
This is a pretty complete set - it includes any brush or dotter you'll really ever need. They're also in a cool case with a little info page explaining the different brushes.

- The case is sturdy and makes the set very, very giftable! It looks pretty great.
- There are 2 brushes for acrylic paint, 6 for regular nail art, 2 for gel polish, and 2 double sided dotting pen/tools. That's a pretty complete set. If you're gifting it, you could sweeten the package by including polish, a bottle of polish remover, a small painter's palette, and precision-tip q-tips! But, all the brushes are included in this set.
- The two dotting pens are double-sided so there are 4 different dotters that give you a fantastic range. Can't imagine you needing any smaller or larger ones. They also have really cool sanded wood handles. I like the feel of them.
- The brushes have an awesome range, too. They're colour-coded and labelled by type (acrylic, regular polish, gel polish).
- Now the info sheet says to use polish thinner (or rubbing alcohol for gel polish) to clean them. I tried this and it just made it clumpy (maybe my thinner isn't a good brand for it!). It specifically says to avoid acetone but I used pure acetone to clean them which worked fine EXCEPT that it stripped the paint off the handle of the brushes. NON-acetone remover cleaned the brushes, didn't damage the bristles, and didn't strip the paint so that's what I recommend, personally. Non-acetone polish remover is your best bet. Just be gentle, no matter what you use, to avoid damaging the bristles.
- Overall, I love this little set and it's a great addition to my nail art collection.

I bought this discounted in return for my opinions and review.

title: Permanent lightening with consistent use
text:
This product is intended for permanent skin lightening and will require weeks to take effect. So if you are looking for immediate results, I recommend Shouvy's BB whitening cream with SPF30; it is a cosmetic lotion which gives instant whitening but does not physically alter skin tone.

This is a blend of effective natural whitening agents with additional properties beneficial for skin. These ingredients have been demonstrated to even skin tone, lighten hyperpigmentation, build collagen and inhibit the production of melanin. The skin lightening agents in this product are as follows. Google each for further information, but in brief summary:

Glutathione has been called the mother of all anti-oxidants. Clinical research has shown glutathione significantly lowers the skin's melanin content in as little as 10 weeks.

Kojic acid is derived from mushrooms, used as a skin lightening agent because it inhibits the protein tyrosinase from producing melanin. Kojic acid alone has shown effects faster than most other lightening agents, beginning at about 6 weeks.

Even faster is Artocarpus Lakoocha Heartwood extract. Used alone, it has shown significant whitening effect after only 4 weeks of application.

Coenzyme Q10 aka ubiquinone is a chemical substance naturally produced by our own cells. Applied topically, it can help lighten freckles, age spots, acne scars, and other discolourations. Q10 may also help enhance regeneration of skin cells, thereby reducing the appearance of wrinkles.

Vitamin C provides surprisingly high level lightening and increased UV protection while helping to fade sun/age spots and freckles. Vitamin C is also proven to boost glutathione levels which further helps lighten skin. It also enhances collagen synthesis and increases cell turnover, which makes it a popular ingredient in anti-aging serums.

All together this should be effective in treating melasma (dark pigmentation), acne scars, freckles and age spots. The company does not mention SPF but the inclusion of titanium dioxide, coenzyme Q10 and vitamin C would be expected to provide some degree of UV protection.

Before applying whitening lotion, you should perform a patch test. This is a good practice before using any skin care product, but especially those containing parabens. (common allergen) Just dab a little on your wrist or inner elbow and wait a few minutes. If you experience any signs of irritation such as redness, itch, or swelling, of course discontinue use.

My skin is somewhat pale, but tans easily, so I always have one arm darker than the other simply from being exposed to sunlight in the car. I will conduct an experiment using this lotion on the one arm only, and report my findings. Whitening creams do require several weeks to produce results, and the effect increases over time. For now I can only say that it goes on smooth and silky and has a pleasant scent.

***EDIT - I've now been using this product for several months, and just raised my rating from 3 stars to 4. Yes this lotion actually does work. Not surprising, with those ingredients. If you don't mind using a product that physically alters your skin's production of melanin, and are willing to use this daily, it will absolutely lighten your complexion a shade or two. Just be patient and give it two or three months to achieve full lightening potential.

This serum is really refreshing and I use it every night on my face and neck. You can use it morning and night, but I just chose to apply it before bed. I pour about a third of a dropper full into my hand and rub it in gently. I have severely dry skin and it has helped keep the dryness and flakes at bay, which is wonderful. title: The only review of this tape that counts.
text:
Firstly, I'll say that I've had nothing but Glam-Seamless tape extensions in my hair for two years now. I've tried everything from the super-blue to the basic tape, and recently got this for my first time.
Ok not sure what junk these complainers and low-star raters were smoking, because there's no way you could say anything but amazing things about this tape.
99% of the time I have my extensions put in with other tape, within 3 weeks and maybe 9 + washes, the first few of my extensions are slipping out. By 6 weeks, I have few, if any still in, with 2-3" between my scalp and the extension, therefore, they're popping out of my head and look ridiculous.
After my first time using the Duo-Pro, not only did NONE of them slip out in 8 weeks, but they moved slower away from my scalp than ANY tape I have EVER used. They're amazing. If I didn't want them refreshed and tight to my scalp like I prefer, I could have left them in for quite a few more weeks. This is THE BEST adhesive tape I've ever used and the only one I'll ever use going forward.

Clean up: raw coconut oil to saturate the strands and rub between the tape bond, despite how strong the tape is, it comes out easily, pain free and you'll lose almost no hair at all. You just need patience taking them out.

title: Great cloth for removing makeup. Equal to the Makeup Eraser
text:
I love the idea of these makeup removing rags. It saves a lot of money to be able to buy one product that removes makeup, oil, and dirt without having to buy makeup wipes, cleanser, and all the other products that we spend money on to clean makeup off of our faces.
I will be comparing this product to the name brand Makeup Eraser http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00KBPSUYC?psc=1&redirect=true&ref_=oh_aui_detailpage_o05_s00 that I bought off Amazon as well and have had since June 16th 2015 so I can see if they are the same of different.

Makeup Eraser Claims:

Makeup Eraser removes 100% of your makeup with just water.
Removes mascara including waterproof mascara in just seconds.
Cloth is approximately 7" wide x 16" long.
All natural, no chemicals, and machine washable.
Use up to 1000 times and everything comes clean;no stains and remains soft. Promotes healthy skin.

Makeup Remover Claims:

Reusable. Simply clean it in the wash for a brand new cloth, again and again.
Absolutely NO harsh chemicals on your face
Super soft material that is gentle on the skin
Clears away hard to remove makeup with less effort

Makeup Remover (purple) Pros and cons Vs. The Makeup Eraser (pink)
* Both cloths are soft and both sides feel the same as the other.
*The purple cloth is a tad bigger than the pink cloth which is nice.
* They both remove waterproof mascara easily along with other regular makeup.
* They both wash up the same.
* The makeup eraser feels thicker than the Makeup Remover but does not affect the makeup removers ability to remove makeup.
*The price is quite different. The Makeup Remover (purple) is around $13.00 and the Makeup Eraser is around $20.00 for pretty much the exact same thing.

If you are looking for a way to save money and want a cheaper version than the Makeup Eraser but performs the exact same, I would go with the Makeup remover. Save that extra money because this cloth performs the same thing as the Makeup Eraser.

* I was sent the makeup remover cloth at a discounted price for my ubiased review. I bought the Makeup Eraser at full price. All opinions and comparisons are my own.

That being said, it's a bit of a mixed bag. Most of them are a sort of matte, plastic look, which I find boring, and one of them was absolutely atrocious (the sugar crush pink). It was like I was painting gravel onto my nails, which felt gross.

There are also a couple of real gems in here, though, that I didn't expect. The black glitter looks like outer space on your nails, it's one of my new favorites. There's also a pearl white that's great for a lot of designs I like to do (white layered with pink and red for Valentine's day, or with shades of blue for New Year's/winter months). I haven't tried the green yet, but that looks like it could be a great one too, with almost yellow glitter in it, it has a color-changing effect in the bottle.

text: This is my first foray into the use of beard oil. Over recent months, as I grew my goatee longer, I started noticing some flakiness on my chin (always clean and well groomed), and that my beard hairs were becoming drier and stiff. After using this for about a month, and giving a small quantity to a friend to try, I still have most of the bottle full. title: strong performance
text:
I bought this as a blind buy, as there were no reviews on this fragrance.
I used to really like the original Candies, from back in the day. I was so upset when it was discontinued.
That said, my nostalgia got the best of me when I saw this on Amazon. I don’t recall what the original Candies smelled like, so its hard to say how close this is to the OG formulation, but this one smells really sweet. My initial response to it was “aqua net hairspray with citrus magic”. It is very ‘orangey’, and the citrus is huge here.
Once the hairspray smell goes away, it smells rather nice. It doesn’t smell expensive, you can tell it’s not a high end fragrance, but it’s nice. I wouldn’t buy another bottle, though. Same thing with the Candies Black (which I also bought- blindly). I wouldn’t renew either of these, but it was not a waste. They smell “OK” enough to wear out, and the projection is intense. These “new” Candies frags will make people around you get a headache, if you take a bath in them. A few sprays is literally all you need. Both are extremely strong, and the scent lasts a while on the skin, and a very long time on clothing.
It has a little bit of a gourmand thing going on after it dries...it smells like lemans and oranges. I suppose wanting to eat it is why it’s called “Candies”, so in that regard, kudos.
There’s something going on beneath all the citrus, but I cannot for the life of me put my finger on it.
Just know this is very sweet, like Invuctus, but “cheaper” smelling. It’s really not terrible, but they’re not for me.
A teenager may love these Candies fragrances, but if you are over 30, you may want to think again.

title: Not So E-Z
text: My mom and I both received these as gifts.  It does not stay put and can actually throw you off balance when it goes sliding.  The actual product for both of ours is also different from the pic on the box.  Ours both have very long, firm bristles top and bottom that are difficult to move back and forth through, and there are bristles completely surrounding the pumice stone so that you can't really get to it.  The pic on the box and the advertisements show no bristles at the back of the "shoe" behind the pumice stone, only in front of it, so that it's actually accessible.  The way these are made, the stone might as well not be there, because you can't use it. I'm not even sure it's an actual pumice stone after running my fingers over it--it feels artificial and has a different texture than pumice.  It's a good concept, and will at least take off surface dirt--if you can hang on to it.  I actually worry about it causing seniors to fall, instead of preventing it. I have to think there are different models; I looked online at the commercial and the plastic looks different and there are several colors, plus no bristles at the back.  It says EZ Feet on the box, but it looks like this may be a cheaper model than the one they push on their site and their commercials.

title: Love these towels!
text:
I do quite a bit of backpacking and canoe camping.
I always bring a few of these compact towels with me on my trips.
They take up very little space in my pack and weigh next to nothing.
However, when you add a tablespoon or so of water to one, it puffs out, unrolls, and you have a fully functional washcloth for cleaning yourself, your gear, doing the dishes, etc.
They are durable enough that you will get multiple uses out of each one. I have even washed one in my machine at home and reused it.
They are made of cotton, I think, so they are biodegradable. I don't recommend burying them in a cat hole or anything though, as they won't break down fast enough to allow that. I have used them as a TP substitute once or twice, and they are awesome for that, but I always burn them or pack them out afterwards.
I really like these towels.
They are an excellent value for the money.
Perfect for traveling, backpacking, camping, etc.
Highly recommended.

The pads are extremely wet, as in dripping, so there's plenty of essence on them. It takes a while for my face to dry because of this. I don't detect a scent, nor is there any tingling or anything when I apply.

These dry out my combo-oily/acne-prone/aging skin, so I must use a moisturizer after my face dries or I get that tight feeling and "pull" marks on my cheeks. These add no moisturization at all to my skin. The good news is these pads do tighten up the looks of my pores and are helping to keep acne at bay.

As long as moisturizer is used after this step, I like these.

title: I rigged mine to dry completely
text:
These are some high-quality loofahs! They're very thick and a good overall size. The handle makes it very easy to hold and I find the loofah part plenty scrubby for my skin.

With anything like this, it's critical it be allowed to dry completely to cut down on bacterial growth. I've included a picture of how I rigged mine to dry. I took one of those suction hook thingies, wedged it between two metal pieces of my shower caddy, and hang my loofah to dry. The important part of this is that in doing it this way, no part of the loofah itself touches anything. I read years ago that wherever something like this touches something else while drying, bacteria can collect there. I'm no scientist, but it makes sense to me, so that's how I've hung stuff like this for years. Works like a charm. I also love that I can throw these in the washing machine.

These are very nice loofahs and I recommend them.

title: A must-have for me (with a tip for you)
text:
I've kept a squirt bottle of water under my sink for years. I cut my own hair, so I spray it down before doing so. With a regular spray bottle, I always end up getting a lot of water on the floor when spraying my hair, then have a problem cleaning up the floor after cutting my hair as my hair is stuck to the wet floor.

This bottle has solved my problem. The mist from this bottle is consistently super-fine. No rogue giant droplets. I can spray my hair down and not get water everywhere. The bottle is easy to hold, is a great weight and is balanced well. The trigger is easy to pull.

This bottle is perfect to use for homemade wrinkle reducer for clothing as well. I just mix one cup of water and a tablespoon of fabric softener, shake well, then spray on fabric while pulling down on the fabric. The micro-fine mist dispenses a perfect light spray, so the fabric dries quickly.

This bottle is very easy to clean so I can use it for several things, but I'd like to get more so I can stop switching the contents out.

Definitely recommend.

title: Hair Saver!
text:
When I went through chemotherapy, I lost most of my hair, and as a woman this was a real blow to my self image. This trio of products was recommended to me by the woman who runs our local health food store, and along with taking an oral biotin supplement (5,000 mcg per day), I used this three-step system (shampoo, conditioner, and leave-in serum) to wash and condition my hair. Between the two approaches, both oral and topical, I re-grew all of my original hair, and now my hairdresser swears that I have more hair now than I did before I was diagnosed with cancer and went through chemotherapy. It does feel thicker to me now, too, and my husband has also remarked that my hair has never looked better.

The only caveat is that if you have longer hair you may need an extra conditioner for the ends. Otherwise, I would highly recommend this product (plus oral biotin supplements) to anyone who has had hair loss due to chemotherapy. I was very satisfied with the results. Minus one star only because the conditioner doesn't work quite as well on longer hair, but it is more important that you apply this product to the scalp, so again you can use a more silky conditioner for the ends.

title: Not worth the hassle
text:
At first I thought this was the greatest razor ever. It provides a smooth shave, probably the best shave I've ever encountered. I have very sensitive skin, so I have to be selective. First impressions: It is a very sleek and cool looking razor. It is so fancy, that I am afraid of breaking it every time I touch it. The problem with this razor is not its performance, rather it is the maintenance. The lotion is expensive, and to make things worse, it is nearly impossible to find, unless you are willing to spend lots of money and buy it online. But, the razor works, so I stuck it out.

Next problem: Norelco suggests that you replace the cartridge for sanitary reasons each time you refill the lotion. OK, but when I ordered the lotion (which is supposed to come with the cartridge), THERE WAS NO CARTRIDGE! So, I decided to stick it out anyway. Each time I replaced the lotion, I would just remove the cartridge and clean it myself. That seemed fine, until this morning when I accidentally broke a piece of this fragile cartridge. Now, I can't get the lotion to come out, so the razor is ineffective. I tried to buy a new lotion with cartridge at Target, and the lotion came without the cartridge, so I have to return it.

I know Phillips-Norelco has excellent customer service, so I called to see if they could help me. It turns out that the lotion does not always come with the cartridge (although it is advertised that way and I was told that it came with the cartridge by a customer service rep before I bought the razor). So, it's kind of like a little guessing game. Where can I find the lotion and cartridge together? Fun! I asked if they could just send me some cartridges, no lotion, just cartridges and I'd be happy. But they could not do that, so I am going to return this razor and get my money back.

I still have a previous Norelco shaver (dry) and I will try that again, although it is not as good. I think in the end I may have to resort back to the painful manual razor shave. I have been a Norelco customer for many years and up to this point I was always very pleased, this is disappointing.

To summarize: This is an excellent razor, but it is not worth the money or the hassle you have to go through to make it work effectively!

I welcome any shaving advice to help my sensitive skin!

title: Hair is lovely and reverts back after washing it!
text:
I was pleased that her hair reverted back after I washed it. It's great to finally see more and more cosmetology mannequins with African textured hair that actually reverts back to its coily texture after you wash it. So often in the past, sellers would advertise cosmetology mannequins as having afro hair, then you washed it and the coil pattern was completely gone. The money I lost trying to find a real African textured cosmetology mannequin back in the day, was unbelievable!

A few things to note.....While washing her hair there was tons of shedding. I've come to realize this is quite normal. However, after the washing is said and done, the shedding is minimal. Thank goodness because there are cosmetology mannequins where the shedding continues in massive balls even after washing.

The ends are thin and stringy and that's where I'll take a one star deduction. She'll be gettin a good trim here soon, but I definitely recommend her. I'd say her hair is in the 3b/3c range? I could be off about that because I'm still a bit shaky on the hair typing system. Either way, you'll definitely be satisfied with your purchase.

I've attached pictures of before washing her hair, after washing her hair and what her hair looks like after I dried it and dry combed it. Lovely soft hair. I almost didn't wanna ruin the rod set because it was so cute but I always wash the hair of any cosmetology mannequin I buy, right outta the box.

title: Confusing marketing.....
text:
The seller really should change their description of this hair dryer.

First, the pictures make it look as if you can use the concentrators in either the vertical or horizontal position and this isn't true at all. In the horizontal position, the concentrator will fall off because it will not lock.....see promotion picture and my uploaded photo.

****This may not seem like a big deal until you start using it and have to adjust the direction with your wrist.****

Second, the description states the wattage is between 1800 to 2000 but the label says 1800 watts only....see description paragraph and my uploaded photo.

While the blow dryer is cute and an obvious design copy from the Dyson blow dryer (seems China has been copying Dyson these days but can't match the superior quality of Dyson), it's kinda heavy and gets too hot, even on the medium heat setting. I had to turn on the cool shot to offset the heat.

If you have hand arthritis, carpal tunnel, shoulder arthritis, etc, this will give you some trouble due to the heaviness, along with the inability to switch the concentrator into the horizontal position.

2 star deduction for the deceptive advertising, lack of concentrator versatility and heaviness.

title: No mess, no fuss but patience needed!
text:
I was dire hard fan of Nair Roll On Wax Hair Remover until they stopped making it but where Nair failed with their roll on wax was the mess......dripping bottle with no way to stand the bottle of wax upright unless propped against something. In comes Belle!

Let me just say for the record, I bought the purple one with the base because apparently they have the pink one shown that doesn't come with the base. (I'm gonna order that one but I'll get to that in just a minute). This system is wonderful.....no mess, nice and clean and you can keep it on the base so that means it's upright and no worries about dripping wax. Once you've used it, I'd suggest wiping the wax head off just to get the wax residue off from your usage.

The base comes with an additional plug outlet on the side which is why I'm ordering the pink one for 14.99. It appears you can heat two cartridges at the same time and I'm ecstatic about that.

The wax it came with went on smooth and to my surprise only needed one more application to remove my underarm hair. Put a little baby powder under your arm prior to waxing as this will create a smoother process and absorb any oil and moisture. With the Nair Roll On Wax, I sometimes had to do three to four applications to get all the hair and ya know that's not good for your skin when you're waxing.

Now for the one star deduction.....I went back and forth with whether I should give 5 stars or 4 stars but I think 4 stars is still pretty darn good. The reason for this is the time it takes to heat the wax up. It took mine 25 minutes. That can seem like a long time when you're used to putting wax in the microwave and it's ready under 2 minutes. It's only a minor issue however the system definitely makes up for this plus you can order more cartridges in different scents.

Overall, great buy and you won't regret it. If you were a Nair Roll On Hair Remover fan like I was, you can kiss the days of paying for overpriced Nair rollers on Amazon goodbye, since they've discontinued it and third party sellers are trying to make an insane profit.

Edit to add......so apparently the pink one cannot be attached to the extra outlet. That outlet is for a different voltage but what the heck, I ordered it anyway. Can't go wrong with more than one hair removal system. I'll do a separate review on that one once I get it.

The Applicator was a decent size and easy to use.
The Case fits 2 sets of Eyelashes and the kit comes with 3 sets of Eyelashes.

I ended up applying my normal liquid liner, then going over it with the Magnetic Liner to get a more even look.
I do suggest giving a good amount of application to the Eyeliner to reassure they are secure.

The Removing Process definitely takes some time. You really have to soak your Eyelashes with remover to get all of the sticky pieces of Magnetic Eyeliner off.

All in all, they are good Magnetic Eyelashes. I would definitely recommend them. However, they do not get a full 5 stars, because the Eyeliner dries pretty quickly and it does take quite some time to completely clean the Eyeliner off.

title: Another great product from this company.
text:
Aloe vera is used for a huge number of things ranging from treatment of sunburns, cold sores, psoriasis, and even constipation. Me? I have extremely sensitive skin and am extremely forgetful of putting on sunscreen when working or playing in the sun. Aloe vera gel is a must have for me. It does everything you'd expect an aloe vera gel to do, and the cooling effect is very soothing. The smell is a little bit off, but I assume it's because of the organic nature of hte product and it's nothing too off-putting. Tt works extremely well so I have no gripes. I haven't had a chance to use this on a sunburn, seeing as I purchased this in the dead of winter, but from my use for other ailments I suspect it would do just fine when I inevitably get that first taste of redness.

I purchased this product because of Beauty by Earth's commitment to organic products and solid business practices. They don't test on animals, is safe to use for vegans, and is made in the USA. I'll always try to support domestic companies over foreign competitors, and they give me the chance to do that. Although I did purchase this product at a small discount in exchange for my review, the review is honest and unbiased in every way. title: 3 Pack (White/Slate/Lake blue) of the Niutop Watchband Style Band for Fitbit One
text:
This review is for the 3 Pack (White/Slate/Lake blue) of the Niutop Watchband Style Band for Fitbit One. I received a promotional discount on this item in exchange for providing a review. I have been using this item daily for a little over a month and wanted to share my experience.

First Impressions
* The items were exactly as pictured, the colors really bright and crisp.
* It took some work getting the FitBit One in and out of the band. It gets a little easier the more you use it. I do not view this as a problem as I know its not going to fall out.
* Was not easy to insert the fasteners on the one end of the band to the connectors on the other. This is still and issue, but again, I do not view this as a negative as I can trust that it will remain secure, but it can be a pain, easier with help, to fasten it.

Observations from wearing.
* The FitBit One was very secure in the band, never worried nor experienced it falling out, coming loose, etc.
* Once fastened securely the band never unsnapped by accident.
* After the first week or so I started to get a rash on my wrist. I switched it to the other wrist and experienced the same thing. I took off the band, removed the FitBit, then washed the band in soap and water. I wore it for several weeks after this, on the same wrist, and did not experience any issues.
* I was used to clipping my FitBit to my pocket or shirt, and do not normally wear a watch. I did not have any problem wearing it, was very comfortable and often forgot I even had it on. It did take some getting used to, remember to remove for a shower, and not getting it overly wet while washing my hands, but I got used to it very quickly.
* I did notice a few occasions that if I made exaggerated arm movements it would trigger as steps on my FitBit one.

Overall
I would recommend this for anyone looking for a watchband style carry for their FitBit. I use mine daily and I not even considered going back to clip style carry. I do recommend that when you first receive it that you wash it with soap and water, rinse and let dry before using. You will never need to worry about the FitBit becoming unsecured from the band.

title: Norelco finally got it right!
text:
I have used electric razors for over 35 years all have good points and all have weaknesses. Norelco razors have two problems.

Hard to clean. As the cutter and blades fill up the motor is not able to maintain the speed and nicks result. You must take the blade and cutter assembly apart to clean properly and if you cut longer hairs by accident(side burn area etc.) it will wrap around the cutting blade and really slow the motor down. The motor slowing is the worst on the new "3 blade" called the Speed XL, they just seem to be underpowered.(just as a note the older Spectra blade replacements fit these razors and seem to work better). Think of this problem like a paper shredder that has not beeen emptied and hasn't room for more papers in the bin.

Hidden Build up. I have changed batteries in several of my Norelco shavers and the build up of gunk where only disassembly could find and cure it, is remarkable(same with most brands). I suspect this is gunk is high in bacteria and the cause of most skin infections from nicks. The stuff you never knew was there is nasty!

Now for the cure: Norelco 8060x! This razor blade assembly has open backs for the stubble to fall through as you shave. I use mine in the shower so no mess. The blade assembly is completely seperate from the motor unit= no place for gunk to build up! The unit is entirely water proof. The blades disassemble easily so you can get at those occasional "longer hairs" that wrap around the cutters. The cutters have more blades on each, so the shave is faster and the motor seems stronger than previous models, hence less slowing. The Nivea solution is great, but you can use regular shave cream or gel. I like the Nivea Gel for Sensitive Skin, it seems to be the right thickness for the razor and works alomost as well as the cream you load in the razor.

The only negative for some people might be the size or shape of the handle, it is smaleer and lighter than most shavers. Some people with larger hands may find is inconvient and others may find it easy to drop.

Overall this is the best all around razor I have owned, there is a brief time required for your face to get used to any new razor... This ones worth it!!

text:
From the female of the family: this is a relatively expensive product, and the write-up is technical, so you do want to know it works, right? It does, at least for me. I'm careful to treat my facial skin with care and good products, and while I know you cannot really stop the aging process, you can both plump up and repair dry and irritated skin.

This product does all of that. It contains some things you've probably heard about -- reservatrol, which does help rejuvenate, a concentration of an ingredient found in red wine, something of a miracle product in itself. Then there's hempseed oil which calms irritated skin and St. John's Wort, a venerable ingredient know as well to sooth and heal.

I wash my hands well, then my face and pat it dry. I drip a little serum in my palm (not touching the dropper so I don't contaminate the product in the jar), dip in lightly with the tips of the fingers of my other hand, and lightly massage it over my face. A little goes a long way, so don't overuse it.

I don't use a lot of makeup, so the problems some others had with the combination doesn't bother me. Nor do I find it too sticky -- again, don't lay it on thick.

Here's the full list of ingredients: Water, Glycerin, Pentylene glycol, Niacinamide, Centella asiatica extract, N-Palmitoyl serinol (Neuromide), Bifida ferment lysate, Acetyl glucosamine, Phytosterols, Cannabis sativa seed oil, Allantoin, Panthenol, Sodium hyaluronate, Sialyllactose, Hypericum perforatum flower extract (St.John's wort), Carbomer, Adenosine, Ceramide NP, Resveratrol, Heptasodium hexacarboxymethyl dipeptide-12, Glyceryl acrylate/Acrylic acid copolymer, 1,2-Hexanediol, Polyglyceryl-10 distearate, Glyceryl stearate, Caprylic/Capric triglyceride, Sorbitan stearate, Stearic acid, Glyceryl Caprylate.

title: Fresh Pure scent is terrific!
text:
Personally, I prefer the deodorant-only products that are easy to wash off, whereas I find that antiperspirants seem to stick to me in the shower and have to be scrubbed off or else they build up over time. On me, antiperspirants also darken my armpits.

Keep in mind if you are ordering [[ASIN:B00NQ2CCOQ Genuine Authentic German Nivea Deodorant Fresh Pure Aluminum Free 1.69 fl.oz / 50ml]] deordorant, it is *just* a deodorant, and *not* an antiperspirant. Which means your armpits can sweat. Which means that while *you* won't smell (because you are wearing a deodorant), your clothes *will* after the sweat dries on them. So you will only get a single wearing out of a shirt if you sweat, but my clothes are washable, so that is OK with me. If I had to pay for dry-cleaning, I might have a different opinion.

I've tried this scent (Fresh Pure) and another scent (Fresh Natural) and the Fresh Pure scent is terrific. The other one I did not like, although another reviewer did, so your experience may vary.

text:
I have thick, long, straight hair. it's hard to find clips that can hold all of my hair at the store that aren't obnoxiously huge. And these hair claws DID NOT work to create that single neat easy bun look on my head. So I was honestly disappointed in these. it seemed like they were just for those individuals with thin hair. I thought it was the end of these and my money was wasted.

However, if you have thick hair like me and you do pigtails, I found that you can use these for two separate buns, and they actually look cute! These things creak a little when opening but overall, they are reliable, reusable, and comfortable. I simply use a comb to split my hair into two even bunches. I use a hair tie on each side and then twist up my hair and use a hair claw to hold it in place in a bun. My buns stay up all-day with a strong hold. I recommend storing them closed in shape to avoid them losing their tenacity and shape.

title: Wow, super-heavy and solid!  This extra "arm" really works!
text:
I admit that I felt silly buying this...but I HATE to blow-dry my hair because I have very thick, wavy, and frizz-prone hair. So usually when I blow-dry it, I can't use the brush properly like a hairdresser would to really work the frizz out and dry it properly and it ends up look dry and poofy until the next day when it settles down. I typically let my hair just wet-dry and then style with some cream and a curling iron to smooth my ends. But when I saw this, I just had to try it despite having a small bathroom and thinking "do you really want that thing hanging on you wall?" The answer is..."Not really, but I really want a free hand to dry my hair."

So I bought it. Although I was still really unsure about the safety of sectioning this thing to my wall. I imagined it crashing down and smashing my toiletries, injuring the cat, or crashing onto someone's head. I wondered why I decided to buy it. But then I received it in the mail, opened it, and was really surprised at how incredibly heavy and solid this thing is. Everytime I buy a product that is supposed to "suction" and be strong....it isn't. Well, this one is REALLY strong.

I first tested it by suctioning it to the wall (not the mirror as shown in the ad) and left it there for about 2 days just to see if there was any sliding, slipping, or loosening. I pulled HARD on it various ways to try to get it to fall down. This thing is 100% solid and the suction is super-strong. If it stuck to my painted wall, this would never come off a mirror! Then after I inspected it a good bit, bent the arm around, tried out the bungee, and figured out which way the holder that the blow-dryer goes in is supposed to go....I placed my hair dryer in it. I had a hard time, at first getting my dryer to fit because I still had the holder upside down. If the large bolt is pressing against the back of your dryer, it's upside down and it won't seat properly and the bungee will be super-hard to clip (or not at all). So I was like "great this thing doesn't fit my dryer". But you have to twist and move it around to figure out which way yours fits and then it's all pretty much smooth sailing from there.

The "arm" that bends is also really hard to bend and very solid and thick. Merely bumping it (which I did several times), walking into it, or yanking your dryer around doesn't make this flop around. It requires two hands to bend and stays firmly in whatever position you place it for drying. Keep in mind this means that other than minor adjustments, if you need to totally change the dryer position while drying...you will need to take a second to move the arm and reposition it a bit, which is not a one-handed job. I really like that about this. When I finally tried using it after my shower (after days of leaving it hang up to ensure it doesn't fall, playing around with it, and letting my family get used to it being in their way because of our small bathroom) I was delighted that when I moved the dryer lower to blow straight at me....it stayed firmly in place, even after accidentally slapping it with my hairbrush and hands several times. I moved it into a "downward" blowing position about halfway through to get the back and was able to not only use a brush and my hands like a normal person, but I noted that I was able to get my hair dry in half the normal time (I assume because of extra brushes and hands). My hair even looked less frizzy and more like what it should look like after I go to the salon! My significant other came home and laughed when he saw me awkwardly using it and trying to position it right....but he thinks it's cool, too.

It made my life much easier and really DOES function like a permanent fixture if you want it to. I plan to leave mine up all of the time for ease of use rather than redoing the suction and placement each time. It's easy to just take the arm and push it up really high when you're done, take the dryer out of it, and it's out of the way of anyone walking through, opening cabinets, etc until next time you want to use it.

This is a pretty innovative product and I don't feel like I wasted money on it because it has made a loathsome part of my beauty routine easier...even if it did make my bathroom just slightly uglier :-)

In all seriousness, if you have space or really hate trying to use a brush and properly dry your hair, this is worth it. If I had more storage nearby, I'd probably take it down in between uses because it really is easy to suction and adjust once you understand what goes where and how it works. I had fun trying this out and using it on my hair and plan to keep on using it in the future. It's an odd device, for sure...but doesn't hesitate if you're worried it will be "cheap" or flimsy. This thing could be a deadly weapon, it's so heavy and clearly intended to stay in place. If that's what you need in a dryer holder, absolutely buy this. I don't regret my purchase and I doubt you will, either. I hope you found my review to contain useful information and I am happy to answer any questions you may have. Thanks for reading and happy styling!!

*It was really hard to take clear photos once hung because it's large and I choose to really snake it around, but hopefully you can get an idea of size and set up from them*

text:
I do nails quite often....usually fancy or cute designs; minions are one of my favorites to do. This set is exactly what a girl (or boy, lol) needs to complete nail artwork!!!! This set has been one of my better nail art investments.

What do I love about it? For one, it comes in a handy storage case which makes it hard to lose all the brushes and nail dotters. Plus there is a see through vinyl flap that covers them too. It unrolls three times after you unsnap the buttons and spreads your array of brushes and dotting tools. You end up with a total of 14 brushes that range from fan brushes to fine tipped brushes. There are five double-ended dotters and no, they aren't all the same size. I think a few are. There is also a dotting pen with just one small dot which you could use for line work if the brushes are too hard for you. The entire set is compact and portable.

As for cleaning them....I've had no issue with mine. I cleaned the polish of with nail polish remover, wiped that off, then washed it with dish soap and let dry. One of my brushes became a little stiff but all I did was run my finger across it a few times and smooshed it on my table. The bristled softened right back up.

I will be using this set A LOT! I've included pics of the set and the nails I did for my daughter and niece (before the edges were cleaned up though). did receive this set at a discounted price in exchange for an honest opinion. Everything I have said is based on my experience with using this set.

I should have listened to the negative reviews. After all, if you look at all the videos on youtube, it looks so easy to get beautiful spiral curls. Boy, was I wrong! Despite following all the instructions on various youtube videos, all I got was a frizzy mess. Remember that episode of Friends where Monica went on vacation and there was so much humidity that her hair kept getting bigger and frizzier? That's what my hair ended up looking like (and my hair is naturally stick straight). Also, the glove did very little to protect against the heat - after just a couple seconds, it was too hot for me to touch the curling iron.

I will go back to using a regular curling iron or hot rollers when I want to add a little curl. I'm sorry I wasted my money on this thing.

I bought and used the 'new' style but did not find it as satisfactory -- took longer to obtain good results -- but it was better than shaving or other alternatives. It did remove underarm hair well, better than the original style.
But when I saw the option to buy the first type Epilady again I did and am very happy with it. I would recommend using this type device to others although I know many think it hurts too much -- even my sisters and a couple friends who tried using the Epilady quickly gave it up.
But nicks and cuts from shaving hurt and look bad too -- soooo. After a very short time I no longer even noticed any discomfort. This hair removal product has worked well for me for many, many years and I wouldn't be without it!

If you order these, just know that you may need to skim them over and remove any loose strings of glue. These are cute and stylish. Great for teens or for photo-op.

(As long as there are no missing pieces, like we had! But, I do not know if this is a common occurrence or not. It could be uncommon for this to happen, maybe the person glued it on and it fell of before packaging? It seems as if that is the case, because the peice was not in the package with the clips. I know the makers are human and mistakes happen, but I thought you better know about it, so you would be better informed before purchasing the product.)

Other than the fact that there was this missing peice, these does seem to be nice and my daughter and I both like them as well as others in my family.

Note: I think the one clip, that was missing the peice should had not passed through quality control and got to packing and shipping.

(I also believe the worker needs to pay more attention to what they are doing, to me it seems as if someone was distracted and forgot to clue the 3rd peice on.
It doesn't seem to have had any glue in that spot, from what I can tell.)

I just want people to be aware of what they are getting and make their own choices on if they want to proceed with the purchase or not. (This is the 2nd item I have gotten, the 1st one was the 4 peice set just like this one.)

text:
Ok so I am a natural blond that has dyed my hair red/purple/magenta over the past 4 years. I recently did a box color of magenta on my hair, and it just turned all my hair dark. I could not see the color! I researched online and came upon this. I was really hesitant because I had JUST FINISHED DYING it--doesn't too much processing break hair? But the reviews convinced me.

It might have gotten a little more even (since I didn't put as much on the first night), but it didn't get totally blond.

Keep in mind all of the reds/purples I had tried were permanent dye, so they were inside the hair, not just on the outside. For this to lighten as much as it did was a shock (and I am very happy). I am now a very light strawberry blond, and my hair was NOT wrecked. It was absolutely fine! I plan to try adding semi permanent blue to it and see if I can make a purple over the leftover red.

I bought this brand because my hair dresser uses it. I have very complicated hair extensions. I have them in 4 different colors! Once I have the extensions dyed and dried these are put on. They are just like stickers. Super easy. And I know they stick in my hair since I bought the same brand that I saw my hair dresser using when she first put them in. Make sure you now what kind you need. Be aware that these are double sided.

Another thing is that these come out so easily when you use an extension remover. I buy one right here on Amazon and I pretty much sit and watch tv while I take them out. A little of the remover immediately allows the stickers to come off and release the extension. Beware that sometimes you'll pull the extension without pulling the sticky tab--this will leave the sticky tab in your hair! Use the remover to loosen it up, then get your nail under it to trap the tab TO the extension while you pull the extension from your hair. Then once it is out of your hair pull the tab off the extension to be thrown away. Easy.

title: Effective Lotion for Intense Skin Needs
text:
There is much to appreciate about this Zeroid Intensive Lotion for Severe Dry & Disordered Skin. This is a Korean-made product and I do tend to be a fan of most Korean skin care products.

While I had some concerns, I'm overall pleased with the product's performance. This is a white, smooth lotion that applies easily. While this is being advertised as somewhat of a premium lotion, I'm not sure I can justify continued use - we'll see how it continues to do and if I notice a definite improvement over other products. However, I definitely can't deny that it's effective and it is definitely making my skin look and feel better.

Zeroid is noted as the #1 Dermacosmetic in Korea for the last decade. It's easy to understand why as this product works incredibly well and surprisingly quickly.

Overall, while I am a bit concerned about the manufacturing date and the price point is a touch high I'll continue to use and compare it to other available products. For now, I'll say I'm impressed and happy with the lotion's performance on my troubled skin.

title: Tonica's Sparkling Oxygen Mask Feels Like a Work in Progress
text:
There's much to like about Tonica's Sparkling Oxygen Mask, a unique spa treatment in a bottle offering oxygen skin-energizing treatments in a less than two-ounce canister that one can do easily at home in a matter of minutes.

The experience itself is pleasurable, the canister's pump action offering a bit of the energizing mask that contains acai, resveratol, and grapefruit cell extract to infuse the skin with oxygen, help clear up free radicals, and brighten/even skin tone.

I will admit my initial impression was a bit low given the relatively small canister arrived with a slightly uneven label. This is something I wouldn't expect from what is undeniably a more premium product. I set aside that concern and enthusiastically tried the product. It seems like when the mask settles in the canister that it takes a couple of pumps to get it to dispense, though once it does everything is fine. These are minor bugs, but if they want to tap into the premium market then presentation matters.

It takes very little to apply and it smooths out evenly on the face and you let it activate over the next 5-10 minutes before rinsing it off. I could definitely feel it activate and I will definitely say my face felt vibrant and energized throughout my work day each time I've used it. I noticed on video meetings that I even looked more energized. So, that's pretty cool.

I'm not sure I'm seeing anything resembling a long-term benefit with the mask. This feels like something I'd use on a day when I have an important meeting or am really dressed to impress. The way that it brightens the skin makes me look healthier and more alert. So, it's not a daily use kind of product for me but it's certainly something I can see turning to when my face needs that extra boost because it definitely gives it a rather remarkable boost that looks and feels wonderful.

While packaging and presentation could use some tweaking, I'm still inclined to give this a thumbs up and it's a product I'll continue to use and then I'll evaluate any future purchases once I see how my face looks and feels once this canister is gone.

title: Daily Face Wash is Light, Super Effective
text:
The first time I used the Sia Botanics Vitamin C Face Wash I wasn't super impressed, but there was something about it that I liked so I kept using it on a daily basis. It didn't take me long to realize that I really, really loved this face wash.

It arrives in a relatively small 4-ounce bottle. The face wash includes 20% Vitamin C along with Organic Aloe Vera, MSM, and Organic Rose Hip Oil. It utilizes the actual lemon peel, a process that is noted to contain 5-10 times more vitamins than the lemon juice. The wash is designed to naturally exfoliate, remove blackheads, and naturally lighten the skin.

While the 4-ounce bottle seems quite small, it takes very little to do the job. The wash comes out as a sort of milky lotion that lathers lightly yet effectively. The lemon peel contains citric and phytic acids and I felt that sort of acidic quality on my face, but it was lighter than a typical exfoliant. It left my skin cleaner, but in a healthy way rather than in a glowing way.

This is designed to be a daily face wash. I'm not completely sure I'd use it on a daily basis given its price point, but I have to admit it feels so natural and has been so effective that I may be convinced otherwise by the time this first bottle is actually done. I love the way that it's making my face look and feel and I'm super pleased with the healthier appearance.

For me, this has turned out to be rather gentle giant of a face wash. It's light yet super effective and isn't particularly showy but accomplishes quite a bit in terms of facial health and appearance.

As some other reviews have mentioned, application is key. Since it’s so concentrated, you do need to start with less and then build from there. I mix a single drop with a pea sized amount of my favorite BB cream (Complexion Rescue by Bare Minerals). I use a stippling brush or sometimes just my fingers to apply, let dry for a min while I do my brows and then use a dab (dab, not a drop) as concealer in the places I need a little more coverage. You can also use this product straight, but it will definitely dry much faster and tends to go from light to heavy very quickly, so less is more. Oh yes, and you *must* shake the bottle very well before each use, since it’s a natural serum, it will separate as it sits.

title: Don’t waste your time or money.
text:
It’s been roughly 2 weeks since I dyed my hair and the color is already super faded and patchy. The whole process to bleach, dye and final wash took me almost 4 hours, two boxes of product, one towel and now a blue bathroom sink. My hair did not get fully “hay blonde” that Splat suggests and that’s after using 2 bottles of bleach. I used 2 dark blue dye bottles and only one of the teal.
I waited over 48 hours before I did the first real wash and then have washed my hair every third day to try to preserve the color as long as possible and I can literally see it fading hard every shower and that’s using color safe products. I’m at the 2 week mark and my hair is now green and patchy with bleached hair showing through. I followed the box directions precisely and did everything I was supposed to. I even contacted Splat to get further tips and tricks on making it last and still it sucks. I understand this is an at home kit and I wasn’t really expecting too much from it considering all the reviews I read before hand but I expected more than this. Even the glove are too short in my opinion. They barely go to the beginning of my wrist which meant the dye was able to find its way under the gloves. This dye does truly dye anything it touches so cover literally everything before hand to prevent accidents. I was able to remove it from my skin using some baby oil and a towel so that’s easy but my sink is now blue.
There are further instructions that they should have stated on the box so beginners can get the most out of the box. Like wrapping your hair with a plastic bag or towel during the bleach process to hold on the heat and help with lifting color.
I fully understood what I was writing into when I purchased this. I read everything I could and watched every video I could find so I’m not judging this product on that factor. I gave it two stars because it took way too long and there’s too much maintenance to do to it to really equal out the lasting ability. I have to blow dry it every time I leave the shower or get it wet at all, meaning sweating or if it rains, because it will bleed hard.
I don’t recommend this if you’re looking for something even semi permanent because it’s not. I’d say if you’re looking for something for a couple weeks to go crazy or for a Halloween project but nothing more.

title: No more plastic bottles!
text:
The number one thing I like about this product is that it does not come in a plastic bottle. It’s packaged in a recyclable cardboard box.

Upon first opening the box the scent was a little overpowering for me, very natural woody smell. I was concerned it would leave my hair smelling too strongly. But to my surprise I really liked the scent while in the shower and it did not leave a strong scent in my hair once dried. I like that you can use the bar only where extra conditioning is needed, like on the ends of the hair, and skip the scalp. It didn’t seem to be as moisturizing as some traditional liquid conditioners I’ve used, but it gets the job done and doesn’t leave a grimy feel on the hair.

What I don’t like about this product is that the first two ingredients are alcohol. Alcohol is drying. So it just seems a little counterproductive to use alcohol as the first two ingredients in a moisturizing conditioner.

Overall I do enjoy this product and I would recommend for daily use!

title: Lovely oil with so many uses
text:
I love apricot kernel oil. It definitely one of my favorite carrier oils because it has so many uses. It's nice to have a 16 ounce bottle of cold pressed oil to work with. Here are just a few of the uses for this wonderful oil:

1) Apricot kernel oil for Skin
Apricot kernel oil is good for people with sensitive skin. It is non-irritant and soothing for the skin. It is light and quickly makes the skin soft and smooth. Apricot oil penetrates deep into the skin. It is easy to apply on the skin as it quickly spreads on the skin. It soothes irritated skin. A massage with apricot kernel oil is good for dry, parched skin. It can be used post shower to lock the moisture into the skin. Since it is light, it wont leave a greasy residue. Once absorbed into skin, it provides moisturization for hours. Apricot kernel oil is one of the best carrier oils for massage as it penetrates nicely into the skin and also improves the delivery of essential oils and other herbal agents. This oil is also good for infusing with herbs and absorbing their essence. It can be utilized for various kinds of massage that require an oil.
2. Apricot kernel oil for Hair
Apricot oil is loved by many people around the world for their hair care. When applied to the hair shafts,it helps to detangle hair. These are the health benefits that organic apricot oil provides to hair. It promotes hair growth because of the nutrients in it, especially Vitamin E. It reduces dry scalp problems and helps to achieve gorgeous shiny hair without any greasiness. When used as a hot oil treatment, it conditions the hair and provides them nutrition. It softens the hair, so that they are more manageable and easily combed.
3. As an Under Eye Cream
Apricot oil can be applied just like almond oil for healing under eye skin. It aids in reducing dark circles, puffiness and helps to strengthen the skin around this region. With regular application of apricot kernel oil, one can reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles around the eyes.
4. Face Oil
Apricot kernel oil is a nice face oil, especially when compared to other heavier oils. It helps to improve skin tone, nourish the skin and lower the appearance of aging signs, like wrinkles, lines and blemishes. However, this oil should be avoided by people who are suffering from acne or are prone to acne. That is because it has a comedogenicity of 2. This means that the oil is mildly comedogenic and it can clog skin pores. This may result in acne breakouts and blackheads.
5. Heart Health
Consumption of apricot kernel oil can be a healthy choice for the heart and the cardiovascular system. This oil has demonstrated the ability to lower the risk of heart attack in rats and can possibly perform the same function in humans. You can use apricot oil as a salad dressing and by using it for cooking certain recipes that go well with the flavor of this oil.

I received my oils at a discount for my unbiased review. Thanks for reading and I hope you found my review helpful.

title: GREAT Brush for Blush & Contour!!
text:
I love buying inexpensive items to use with makeup because most of the time you get a really good product at a great price.
On Amazon, there are SO many makeup brushes to choose from, and I've gotten quite a few.
I wanted to try this to use with my blush and contour.
My brush arrived on time and safely in a bubble wrap manila envelope. Sometimes I wonder if other customers get their brushes in this type of packaging, and if so - that is possibly why their brushes arrive broken. Even in a bubble envelope, the brush isn't that well protected, especially knowing the package gets shipped from one post office to another, truck to truck, and so with so many transfers, it's likely to be broken. That isn't the brush's fault...I might add, just the one who ships it. Ding the merchant, not the product.
If the brush breaks after you've used it, just put some super glue <I would suggest Gorilla Glue...it works GREAT and I use it on everything!>.
I would much rather have a $5 brush break then a $40 dollar brush. I wouldn't mind the $5....but no way would I fix a brush that cost $40!! Sounds a little stupid, but if I'm going to pay that much for a makeup rush...it had better be in excellent health and last forever.

Anyway, this brush does a beautiful job with blush and with contouring. The bristles are very soft, not stiff. It's got a straight edge...no slanting of the bristles like other brushes.
It's very easy to clean too. I actually use and makeup remover cloth 6 days <like a baby wipe> and brush the cloth and that removes a ton of makeup without getting the brush wet. One day a week I use a brush shampoo. I have 2 of each makeup brush so I always have a clean one. In cleaning my brushes this way, they have lasted me a lot longer then when I didn't clean them <when I was a lot younger and didn't know any better>.
I will re-purchase if needed and I do recommend!!

title: Very Pleased
text:
This toothbrush was an upgrade from a less-expensive Oral-B model that I used for several years before it finally quit on me. I'm very pleased with this new purchase.

The Oral-B 4000 has much more power than my old toothbrush and gives a deeper clean. My teeth feel cleaner after using this brush, and though I still need to floss I can tell that this brush is doing a more thorough job of cleaning between my teeth. My teeth look whiter and my gums look healthier. I also think the design helps me do a better job of cleaning my back teeth--my jaw is small and there's not a lot of space around my back molars. This brush helps me clean the back teeth very easily, though. I've found the beeps that help you time your brushing are very helpful, and I like having the ability to switch modes. One charge lasts better than a week--nice if you're taking this on trips.

A few minor cons--this brush is heavier than the old one I was using. Not so much that I didn't get used to it quickly, but enough that I noticed. It's got more power, but it's also louder. I also think the pressure indicator is a little awkwardly placed. I've seen it--I think--when I've triggered it most of the time, but the location makes me wonder if I'm missing it sometimes.

The only feature the 5000 has that this brush doesn't is the wireless display screen. I'm not sure what that does, but after using this model I can't see the screen being necessary. I'm very pleased with this toothbrush and hope that it lasts as long as my previous Oral-B toothbrush did.

When I first saw this product on Amazon, I was wary of all of it's good reviews. I want everyone to understand that this is, in fact, a shampoo; it is NOT a cleansing conditioner. This shampoo is sulfate-free and gives a mild lather. I feel like it cleans my scalp and hair sufficiently, without stripping. I color-treat my hair, and this shampoo has never stripped or lightened my color.

As far as moisture is concerned, this adds hydration without weighing my hair down. Yet, it is NOT drying to my hair as so many shampoos are. I have long, fine hair, so that's a significant point. If you read the ingredient list, you will see that this product contains many natural oils and humectants. Given that, I am continually surprised that it doesn't weight my hair down.

After use, my wet hair feels smooth and sleek, but I still need to follow with a conditioner for detangling. Again, this is a shampoo; it is not a cleansing conditioner. Since there is no matching Pure Body Naturals daily conditioner for this shampoo, I have been experimenting with some other argan oil conditioners sold here on Amazon.

No matter your hair type, I think this shampoo can add to your hair health. I highly recommend trying it.

title: Wasn't sure what to expect. :)
text:
I really didn't know what to expect with these Unaone Compressed Towels but must say, I'm pleasantly surprised.

They are a little larger than a penny and about 1/4" high. They look like large size breath mints or antacid tabs (probably good idea to keep them away from kids & pets) and come individually packaged in plastic with an easy tear edge.

I was a bit concerned that you had to soak them in a cup of water to activate but was thrilled when I held the first one under a stream of warm water and it immediately began to expand. After squeezing out the excess water and unfolding, it is the perfect size wipe to tackle a quick clean or mess. The wipe is about the size of one you find in the antibacterial wipes, but much SOFTER! I would be willing to bet that you could also use a water bottle in a pinch and just pour enough water on the tablet to moisten and use if out hiking, running, etc.

I really like that you can throw these in your purse, backpack, glove box, diaper bag, etc. and have a wipe available for use at any time. With these, you will not open a package to find a dried out wipe if not used for a long time---you make them fresh each use!

Very handy, very versatile and a good quality disposable wipe each time. The price could be improved a little bit to make them about 10 cents each, but other than that, highly recommend! :)

title: Good for long hair, difficult at times for short hair
text:
I love this flat iron despite the one problem I have with it. I wish that the flat iron was skinnier. It’s difficult to get close to my head at certain angles due the flat iron size. If my hair was longer, this would not be a problem. I almost returned the product because of the iron size. But I made some changes to the way that I iron my hair & I think it will work despite the iron size.
The features I like about it:
-steam feature - makes my frizzy hair smoother than a normal flat iron does
-high temperature adjustable heat - makes it so I can iron my hair with less passes from the iron, even if my hair is wet when I’m ironing it - my hair is thick and usually requires more passes, even from a high heat iron, and I have never been able to dry my wet hair by ironing it with any other flat iron in the past
-setting buttons are on the inside handle - I was annoyed with this feature at first, but I realized that this makes it safer to leave plugged in when not in use, when you have small children - I have not had the problems I have had in the past with my kids trying to play with the buttons because of their location
-comes with quite a few extra tools including an extra steam compartment and an easy way to fill the steam compartment - the holes for the filling the steam compartment are really small and would be impossible to fill without provided bottle
-comes with chord Velcro strap - this makes it easy to keep organized despite having a long chord in a small bathroom

Despite my problem with the short hair, I decided to keep it because it works so well. I will also say that I don’t believe the steam feature is protective to hair damage. It just makes the flat iron way more affective with less passes.

title: More than satisfied
text:
[[VIDEOID:b7a26be60316cb3ca697412c040cd1b1]] We have 3 cats: different ages (17, 8, 5), hair lengths (short, medium, long), hair types (silky soft fine, coarse, in-between), temperaments (laid back, shy/skittish, impatient/trouble-maker).

My interest in this brush was specifically for our oldest cat. He had spent much of his life outdoors, but we recently shifted him to being an indoor cat due to age, health and inclement weather.

He was a mess and we had to cut out much of the mats and debris.

Since I spend much of my time in the basement he stays there with me and I created a bed for him next to my sewing area and desk. He likes to sleep there and when I need a break, I like to brush him. He has adapted very nicely to being an indoor cat as long as I brush him at least 6-8x's/day. I kid you not.

However, I noticed as we finally got him cleaned up, that certain areas were bothering him when brushed. Careful inspection revealed external skin growths (like moles) and if our old slicker brush happened to hit them, he would let us know it hurt.

I purchased 2 brushes to try on him. One was a silicone brush and this one. While he liked the feel of the silicone brush (as did the other cats), it wasn't effective at actually grooming.

On the other hand, this brush does a remarkably decent job. It's not as efficient as our old style slicker -- and I think that's due to the fact that it has considerably fewer bristles and they are spaced further apart.

It is necessary, though, to wait for the brush to have a considerable amount of hair in it before cleaning by pushing the button. If you try to remove it before it's relatively full, it doesn't do a very good job of removing the hair from the bristles.

When I also tried it on the other cats, my husband's shy/skittish female cat, who has always avoided me like the plague, couldn't get enough of the brush and was actually purring. Of course, as soon as I stood up (I had been on the floor with her), she ran back to him as if to escape from an ogre!

Mr trouble-maker tolerated the brush but was too impatient to stick around for long. Point is, he didn't object to it, he just wasn't in the mood and would rather run around and play. (8-year old Siamese).

My only request was that the next version of this brush have more bristles, closer together. Meanwhile, I will keep my old slicker for cleaning furniture. It does a remarkably good job.

Forgot to mention: my arthritic hands absolutely adore the soft squishy silicone-like handle.
